2020-s-0201.summary: Robotox is a Twitter bot that tweets whenever new pesticides have been authorised by the Brazilian government, for use in the agriculture sector.Robotox is a Twitter bot that tweets whenever new pesticides have been authorised by the Brazilian government, for use in the agriculture sector.
2020-s-0201.impact: Significant. Because information on the authorisation of new pesticides is buried deep in daily state journals, this information was hard to access. By making this information easily and publicly available, Robotox has provided much transparency on what pesticides have been given state authorisation. The Twitter account has around 17.500 followers. The lauch of Robotox was reported by some media outlets, such as Outras Palavras, Hypeness and Open Knowledge Brasil. Also, it was mentioned in some articles, one of them written by Eliane Brum, one of the most important environmental journalists in Brazil. A radio show broadcasted on the radio of the Federal University of Minas Gerais mentioned Robotox in an episode about how science is looking for alternatives to reduce the use of pesticides.
2020-s-0201.authors: Natalia Viana, Babak Fakhamzadeh, Pedro Grigori, Bruno Fonseca
2020-s-0201.summaryJa: ロボトックスは,農薬がブラジル政府によって承認されたときに,農業部門で使用されるための新しい農薬をツイートするTwitterボットです.
2020-s-0201.impactJa: 重要なこと.新しい農薬の承認に関する情報は,毎日の州新聞に深く埋まっているため,この情報はアクセスすることが困難でした.この情報を簡単に公開することで,ロボトックスがどの農薬が州許可を受けたかについて多くの透明性を提供しました.Twitterアカウントには約17,500人のフォロワーがあります.ロボトックスの笑い事は,Outras Palavras,Hypeness,Open Knowledge Brasilなどのメディアによって報告されました. また,いくつかの記事にも言及されました.そのうちの1つは,ブラジルで最も重要な環境ジャーナリストの1人であるエリアン・ブルムが書いた.ミナス・ジェライス連邦大学のラジオで放送されたラジオ番組で,科学が農薬の使用を減らすための代替品を探している方法についてのエピソードでロボトックスが言及されました.

2020-s-0202.summary: TuitionTracker is a tool that projects the net costs for prospective students enrolling in college and allows them to compare the value and outcomes of 3,891 colleges against one another. Unlike other web apps offering historical data to students, TuitionTracker uses a financial projection technique to estimate the tuition to be charged by each institution in the coming year and the expected net cost (which is often much lower). This means that students enrolling in 2020-21 would know the cost of tuition in 2020-21, not be forced to imagine the price based on what it cost in 2017-18.
2020-s-0202.impact: The data produced for this tool went on to power a number of impactful stories. The Hechinger Report produced two of these stories, based on issues relating to the cost of American universities. The first story, reported and written by Emmanuel Felton, focused on Nicholls State University and how that Louisiana college tried to offset cuts in state funding by increasing tuition on low-income students and their families. This became the basis for an on-air story from Soledad O’Brien for her nationally televised show Matter of Fact. The second piece, reported and written by Pete D’Amato, examined skyrocketing tuition prices at elite universities and how the “sticker shock” scares off low-income and minority students from applying, despite the fact that they are likely to receive institutional funding that drops their attendance costs close to zero. Focusing on the University of Chicago and the 2025 milestone when the school is expected to break $100,000 for a year of attendance, D’Amato traced rising tuition prices back to certain accounting tweaks in the 1980s at some small liberal arts schools, which created the byzantine and opaque process of paying for college that we have now. The University of Chicago milestone spurred a piece on the cost of college in The Atlantic, and data on expected cost increases generated state-level stories for public radio stations in Iowa and Vermont. Importantly, the tool itself has been used by many students, as well as the parents and guardians of college-bound students, to learn about the disparity between advertised tuition and the real cost of attendance. It allows comparisons for five different levels of family income. Counselors working with high schoolers have contacted Hechinger Report to say they recommend the tool to prospective college students.
2020-s-0202.summaryJa: チュイショントラッカー (tuitiontracker) は,大学に入学する将来の学生の純コストを予測するツールで, 3,891の大学の価値と結果を互いに比較することができます.他のWebアプリと異なり,学生に歴史的データを提供するチュイショントラッカーでは,次の年に各機関が課金する授業料と予想される純コスト (しばしばはるかに低い) を推定するために,財務予測技術を使用します. 2020-21年に入学する学生は,2020-21年の授業料の費用を知ることになる.
2020-s-0202.impactJa: このツールのために作成されたデータは,多くの影響力のある物語を動かすために使用されました. ヘッチンガーレポートでは,アメリカの大学費用に関する問題に基づいて,これらの物語の2つを制作しました. エマニュエル・フェルトンによって報告され,書かれた最初の物語は,ニコールズ州立大学とルイジアナ大学が低所得学生とその家族への学費の増加によって州資金削減を補償しようとした方法を中心とした.これは,ソレダッド・オ<unk>ブライアンから彼女の全国テレビ番組の事実に関する放送の物語の基礎となった. ピート・ド<unk>アマトが報告し,執筆した第2作品では,エリート大学での授業料の急上昇と低所得と少数派学生が申請するのを脅かすという衝撃が, 制度的な資金を得られ, 授業料をゼロに近く落とした可能性があるという事実にもかかわらず, 予想されるのは, シカゴ大学と2025年の里程碑を振り返ると学校は1年間の授業料で100万ドルの収入を破ると予想されますが <unk>阿マトは 1980年代に些細な文科学校で課金料金の上昇を追いつきましたこれはバイザンス的で不透明な大学費の支払いを生み出したものですシカゴ大学は,Atlanticで大学費を上げ,予想される費用増加に関するデータによってアイオワ州とバーモント州の公共ラジオ局に州レベルでのストーリーが生成されました.重要なことに,ツール自体は多くの学生や大学に通う学生の両親や保護者が,広告の授業料と出席料の実際の費用の違いについて学ぶために使用しています. 高校生との連携を図るカウンセラーたちは,このツールを大学生に推奨する事を伝え,ヘッチンガーレポートに連絡した.

2020-s-0203.summary: This story is a visual tour of the murky middle of the electorate. Pundits and politicians love to talk about "moderate" or "independent" voters, but this story, using data from the Democracy Fund Voter Study Group, shows that those groups of voters are not an ideologically coherent voting bloc. It starts with a venn diagram showing the overlap of these groups, and then uses the venn diagram as a recurring way finder throughout the piece when diving deeper into each one.
2020-s-0203.impact: The story was widely read and addressed a clear blind-spot in media coverage of elections and polling, in which conversations are framed around appealing to "moderate" or "independent" voters. The piece, which contains original analysis, has been cited by other reporters and academics who work in elections and polling.
2020-s-0203.summaryJa: この物語は,選挙人群の暗い中間を視覚的に巡る.学者や政治家たちは"穏健"または"独立"の選挙人について話すことが好きです.しかし,この物語は,民主主義基金投票者研究グループのデータを利用し,これらの投票者集団がイデオロギー的に一貫した投票ブロックではないことを示しています.
2020-s-0203.impactJa: この記事は広く読まれ,選挙と投票に関するメディア報道における明瞭な盲点に対処され,その中で"穏健"または"独立"な選挙人に訴えられるよう会話が枠組化された.オリジナル分析を含むこの記事は,選挙と投票で働く他のジャーナリストや学者の引用を受けた.

2020-s-0204.summary: The post-conflict numbers is a collaborative journalistic project that aims to find out what has happened with the money destined to the implementation of the Colombian Peace Agreement. This project promotes a permanent, and well informed, citizen oversight of the public spending in post-conflict. Journalists and developers worked jointly to gather information of contracts signed by governmental agencies regarding post-conflict, build a database that contained all the information collected and present it through interactive maps to show where those investments have been undertaken.
2020-s-0204.impact: Using the information contained in the database built by journalists of Rutas del Conflicto, reporters from several Colombian regions have published 74 articles included in this project. These pieces are multimedia reports with infographics, videos, images, maps, etc., all uploaded in the same web site. We are also working on a printed publication containing the main 6 special reports to ensure that communities from regions where the Peace Agreement is being implemented have access to the findings concerning them according to their region. Since this is a collaborative project we do not only count with Rutas del Conflicto, Consejo de Redacción and Colombiacheck (the media outlet of Consejo de Redacción), but also VerdadAbierta.com as well as 6 more regional media outlets. All the articles, data visualizations, videos, maps and images have been replicated in all of the participants websites and social media. Colombian government announced in 2017 he creation of a platform to centralize the information about the implementation of the Peace Agreement, called SIIPO. Such platform hasn’t been released as of January 2020. Under such circumstances, The post-conflict numbers stands as the only database that contains the information of hundreds of public contracts derived from the implementation of the Peace Agreement, allowing for citizen overseeing of public spending regarding post-conflict.
2020-s-0204.authors: David Riaño, Daniela Aguirre, Silvia Corredor, Pilar Puentes, Alejandro Ballesteros, Oscar Parra, Ginna Morelo, Claudia Mejía, Diana Salinas, Juan Diego Restrepo, Dora Montero, Camilo Amaya, Laura Gracia, Andrés García
2020-s-0204.summaryJa: 紛争後の数字は,コロンビア平和協定の実施に目的とした資金で何が起こったのか調べることを目的とした共同ジャーナリストプロジェクトです.このプロジェクトは,紛争後の公共支出に対する市民の継続的な,よく知られた監視を促進します. ジャーナリストと開発者は,紛争後の政府機関が締結した契約に関する情報を集めて,収集されたすべての情報を集めたデータベースを構築し,それらの投資が行われた場所を示すインタラクティブな地図を通じて提示しました.
2020-s-0204.impactJa: ルータス・デル・コンフリクトのジャーナリストが作成したデータベースの情報を使って,コロンビアのいくつかの地域からのジャーナリストがこのプロジェクトに含まれる 74 記事を公開しました.これらの作品は,インフォグラフィック,ビデオ,画像,地図などを含むマルチメディアレポートです. また,平和協定が実施されている地域から来た地域の人々が,地域ごとにその調査結果にアクセスできるようにするために,主要6つの特別報告を含む印刷版を制作しています. このプロジェクトが共同プロジェクトであるため,Rutas del Conflicto, Consejo de Redacción,Colombiacheck (Redacciónのメディア機関) とともに,さらに6つの地域メディアとも関わっています.すべての記事,データビジュアライゼーション,ビデオ,地図,画像は参加者のウェブサイトやソーシャルメディアで複製されています. コロンビア政府は2017年に和平協定の実施に関する情報を中央集権するプラットフォームを設立したと発表した.SIIPOと呼ばれるプラットフォームは2020年1月現在公開されていない. このような状況下では,紛争後の数字は,紛争後の公共支出を市民が監視できるように,平和協定の実施から得られた数百件の公共契約の情報を含む唯一のデータベースです.

2020-s-0205.summary: In Lima, capital city of Peru, parks, beaches and other public spaces have been privatized by private companies, by the equivalent of 79 football fields. Through public information requests, I accessed official documents from 8 municipalities that proved that using concession contracts many private companies were in fact obtaining possession of intangible and non-transferable public spaces, between 1994 and 2018. This derived in various social conflicts, which affect thousands of citizens in the designated districts, as well as irregularities in contracts that reveal cases of alleged corruption.
2020-s-0205.impact: The research had a great impact on Lima’s political life. Many local governments decided to review the contracts and, in many cases, those reviews ended in complaints to the General Comptroller of the Republic, whom intervened and recommend the cancelation of the contracts due to the irregularities found. Meanwhile, the academic community, specially of the architecture field, urban planning and social sciences, pronounced on these facts and began investigations on the legal gaps and irregularities found, taking this research as a source. Currently, the Peruvian Congress is holding a debate about a public spaces bill, in order to correct the legal gap that has allowed this kind of contracts to occur for decades. Many local media took interest on the matter, especially on the findings, considering that the case was shown to the public during local elections. Also, it has great impact on the architecture and urban planning faculties, where professors are using the report as an example for their students. It is important to mention that the topic has gain importance during the last years but this is the first report that contains a detail chronicle of the unappropriated use of public spaces by private parties involving local authorities. This report was finalist for the National Journalism Prize of Peru in 2019, in the category 'Journalistic Innovation'.
2020-s-0205.authors: Research, reporting and data analysis: Luis Enrique Pérez Pinto, Web development and application: Anthony Atauqui and Elvis Rivera, Report editor: Milagros Salazar Herrera, Design: Jackeline Cárdenas
2020-s-0205.summaryJa: ペルーの首都リマでは,公園,ビーチ,その他の公共空間が79のサッカー場相当の私有企業によって民営化されました. 公的な情報要求を通じて,私は8の自治体の公式文書にアクセスし, 1994年から2018年の間に,多くの民間企業が譲渡契約を使用して,実際に無形かつ譲渡できない公共空間を所有していることを証明しました. これは,指定された地区の何千人もの市民に影響を与える様々な社会紛争,また,汚職の疑いのある契約の不規則性によって引き起こされた.
2020-s-0205.impactJa: この調査はリマの政治生活に大きな影響を与えた.多くの地方自治体は契約を再検討することを決定し,多くの場合,その再検討は,検出された不規則のために契約をキャンセルすることを勧告する共和国総監に投訴した結果となった. 一方,建築,都市計画,社会科学の学術界は,これらの事実について発言し,この調査を源として受け取り,法律上のギャップと不規則性に関する調査を開始した.現在,ペルー議会は,この種の契約が数十年もの間起こるのを許した法律上のギャップを修正するために,公共空間法案に関する議論を進めています. 地方メディアは,この事件が地方選挙で公開されたことを考慮し,特に調査結果に関心を示し,教授が本報告書を学生に例として利用している建築学部や都市計画学部にも大きな影響を与えている. このレポートは,地方自治体を含む民間人の公共空間の不適切な利用について詳細な記録を収めた最初のレポートである.このレポートは,2019年にペルーの全国ジャーナリズム賞の最終名候補となった.

2020-s-0206.summary: The four-month investigation into how family courts put children at risk by Gillian Friedman, with further data analysis by Saul Marquez, exploring how family courts fail to protect children, leading to abuse and even homicide. The Center for Judicial Excellence shared data files with the Deseret News — helpful, but since the data came from an advocacy group, it had to be vetted for accuracy and to assess for bias. In-house data team member Saul and reporter Gillian carefully fact checked each data point. The data was also verified using other references, including death records, obituaries and news stories.
2020-s-0206.impact: It's really too soon to say how much impact the project will have as state legislatures are just beginning to do their work and that informs policy. But we heard from dozens of people who read the story and then shared their own experiences with famiy court, some good and some bad. It's clear the story raised some awareness of a very serious issue. The story was also widely shared on social media. The Deseret News also received hundreds of messages from parents around the world that said the article was the first time tehy ever saw a news story that reflected their experience with family court.
2020-s-0206.summaryJa: 家庭裁判所が子どもたちを危険にさらす方法について,ジリアン・フリードマンによる4カ月間の調査,サール・マルケスによるさらなるデータ分析により,家庭裁判所が子どもを保護し,虐待,殺人に至る方法がどのように失敗するか探求された.司法卓越センターはデセレットニュースとデータファイルを共有した. 内部データチームメンバーのサウルとジャーナリストのジリアンは,それぞれのデータポイントを注意深く検証した.死亡記録,死典,ニュースストーリーなど他の参照を使用してデータも検証した.
2020-s-0206.impactJa: 州議会が仕事を始めているため,その影響がどれほどあるかを明らかにするにはまだ早いです. しかし,この記事を読んで,家族裁判所に自分の経験を共有した数十人の話を聞いた. 良いことや悪いことなど.明らかにこの話は非常に深刻な問題に対する意識を高めました.この話はソーシャルメディアでも広く共有されました. ニュースには世界中の親から何百ものメッセージが届きましたその記事はテヒが家族法廷での経験を反映したニュース記事を初めて見たと伝えました

2020-s-0207.summary: #MatarAUnHijo (To Kill One's Child) approaches the end point of the chain of victims of child abuse in Mexico: death . The cases registered in this research found how the lack of interest in the three levels of government have had fatal repercussions on the minors' lives. Between 2012 and 2017, almost 2,600 children under 15 were killed . The 42% of them by a family member, in their homes or as a result of child abuse . EMEEQUIS developed a database of homicides and created a methodology which revealed that fathers, mothers and step fathers are the main aggressors.
2020-s-0207.impact: This is the first journalistic research that approaches an integral vision of the causes, ways and consequences of child abuse in Mexico. The three displayed cases answer the questions: who, how and why Mexican families kill. The report was widely commented on radio stations, national television, and retaken on web portals reaching a wider audience. In addition, the methodology created was replicated in the state of Veracruz to discuss this problem at the local level. This caused a first reaction from the government. The president of Mexico, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, spoke about the feature in his matutine conference, promising to reinforce with greater budget the fight against child abuse. One month after publication, the Senate approved the prohibition of corporal punishment as an educational method. Also, members of the Chamber of Deputies, began to discuss legislation to fight against child sexual abuse. Lorena Villavicencio, legislator, called on the Secretaries of Public Education, Health and Government to collaborate in the reduction and attention of cases of abused children. The four texts that make up the research were consolidated as the most read of EMEEQUIS, with an average reading of almost six minutes per article, this is an indicator that one of the main objectives was met: to reach Mexican homes. Nevertheless, the greatest achievement was to break the silence on a hidden and private topic, based on data and a completely new methodology. These entries are also a tool that calls society and governments to assume the commitment to protect children.
2020-s-0207.summaryJa: #マターアウンヒジョ (To Kill One's Child) はメキシコにおける児童虐待被害者の連鎖の終点である死亡に近づいています.この研究で登録された症例では,政府の3層に関心がないことが未成年者の生活に致命的な影響を与えたことが明らかになりました.2012年から2017年の間に,15歳未満のほぼ2,600人の子供が殺害されました.そのうち42%は家族の一員によって,自宅でまたは児童虐待の結果です. EMEEQUISは殺人に関するデータベースを開発し,父親,母親,義父が主な攻撃者であることを明らかにした方法論を作成しました
2020-s-0207.impactJa: これはメキシコにおける児童虐待の原因,方法,結果に関する総合的なビジョンを接近する最初のジャーナリズムの研究である.この3つの事例は,誰が,どのように,なぜメキシコの家庭が殺すという疑問に答えています.このレポートはラジオ局,全国テレビで広くコメントされ,より広範な視聴者に届いたウェブポータルで再開されました. また,作成された方法論は,この問題を地方レベルで議論するために, Veracruz の状態で複製された.これは,政府からの最初の反応を引き起こした.メキシコの大統領,アンドレス・マヌエル・ロペス・オブラドール,その午前会議でこの機能について語り,より多くの予算で児童虐待との闘いを強化すると約束した. 公開後1ヶ月で上院は教育方法として体罰の禁止を承認しまた,議会議員も児童性的虐待防止に関する立法について議論し始めました. Lorena Villavicencio,立法者は,虐待された子どもの症例を減らすこと,注意を払うことにおいて,公共教育,健康,政府長官を協力するよう求めた. この研究を構成する4つの文献は,EMEEQUISで最も読まれている文として統合され,平均的な読書は1記事あたり6分近くで, メキシコの家庭への到達という主な目標の一つが達成されたことを示しています.しかし,最大の成果は,データとまったく新しい方法に基づいた隠れたプライベートな話題の沈黙を破ることでした. この記事がまた社会と政府に対し子供を保護するコミットメントを担うよう呼びかけているツールでもあります

2020-s-0209.summary: Ebola Story is an interactive storytelling game about the challenges of Ebola response in East Africa. The goal was to create an entry point to a story so often told in pieces and easily dismissed by audiences. We often hear that people in DRC and East Africa feel the response is ineffective, while those internationally don't understand the layers of complexity of the response efforts. The goal was to show readers the challenges - poor infrastructure and access, security risks, mistrust of the population, challenges diagnosing cases and with contact tracing - through their own choice of narrative and a
2020-s-0209.impact: This project garnered a large audience for the Elephant and was successful at driving conversation about the response efforts. In particular, readers highlighted how they were unaware of certain issues, such as burial approaches or the frequency of attacks against responders. It also drove a different audience to the Elephant's site, allowing them to grow their audience base regionally and internationally. It also fostered connections between the journalists across borders, and the animator, with whom they hope to collaborate again.
2020-s-0209.authors: Concept, reporting and writing: Carolyn Thompson, Muyisa Kamathe Seros, Juliet Atellah, and Halima Gikandi Illustrator: Kayee Au, PixelStory.co Editor: Stellar Murumba Developer: Gabriel Soare
2020-s-0209.summaryJa: エボラ・ストーリーは,東アフリカにおけるエボラ対策の課題に関するインタラクティブなストーリーテリングゲームです.目的は,しばしば断片的に語り,観客が簡単に否定する物語への入門点を作成することでした.我々はしばしば,DRCと東アフリカの人々は,対応が効果的でないと感じていると聞くが,国際的に対応の複雑性の層を理解していない. 課題は,読者自身による物語の選択と
2020-s-0209.impactJa: このプロジェクトは大象の大きな観客を集め,対応取り組みに関する会話を推進することに成功しました.特に,読者は埋葬方法や応答者に対する攻撃の頻度などの特定の問題についてどのように無知であったかを強調しました.また,別の観客を大象のサイトに駆使し,地域および国際的に聴衆基盤を拡大させました. また国境を越えたジャーナリストと再び協力することを希望するアニメーターとの関係を促進しました

2020-s-0210.summary: In Brazil,at least 43 military police officers are removed from work every day for psychiatric disorders. A worrying fact, especially in a profession whose mission is to protect the citizen. Permanent alert, stress, risky situations, confrontation, fear.And if all this accumulated over the years turns into a disease? What if this is all your profession? How a police officer is seen and treated by the Corporation when he has some kind of psychological distress? Fantástico collected data from all the Brazilian military police, who works directly with conflict, to find out about their mental health. And the result is worrying.
2020-s-0210.impact: This was Fantástico´s first news report using data journalism, all made by us. It took around five months to get all data information needed for analyzing the current scenario of the matter described previously. Unfortunately, Brazil has differences in terms of compliance with the law and responses to access to public security information requests. Once this first step was mostly completed, we took a couple months more to finish producing it all before airing, on September 15<sup>th</sup>. The Institute for Applied Economic Research (Ipea), CICV and FBSP, three of the most important foundations/institutions that uses public security data for their surveys, asked me for sharing the results of my research, so it helps doing future researches about the matter. Indeed, Ipea is starting a study about police victimization. Finally, police officers (especially the ones from the lowest ranks) and health professionals from the military corporations were encouraged to continue their work and denounce the prejudices and damage that the lack of psychological support brings to police officers and, consequently, to society. It was also important to reveal the taboo subject within the militaries, as well as to denounce the prejudice suffered by many police officers who seek psychological assistance in the workplace. We also show the initiatives of some states in Brazil, which maintain activities designed for the military police mental health assistance.
2020-s-0210.authors: Gabriela Rocha, Thiago Guimarães, Ana Carolina Raimundi, Daniel Torres, Jae Ho Ahn
2020-s-0210.summaryJa: ブラジルでは,精神疾患で毎日少なくとも43人の軍警が職から取り除かれる.特に市民を保護する仕事において,これは懸念すべき事実です. 絶えず警戒し,ストレス,危険状況,対立,恐れ.そして,長年にわたって蓄積されたこれらのことがすべて病気に変えてしまったら? これがあなたの職業ならどうでしょう? 精神的な苦痛があるとき,警察官がどのように見られ,どのように扱われるか? ブラジル軍警察のデータを集めて精神状態を調べました結果は心配です
2020-s-0210.impactJa: ブラジルは法律遵守と公安情報の要求に対する対応に関する違いを抱えています.しかし,この状況については,ブラジルは法律遵守に関する意見を持っています. この最初のステップがほとんど完了した後,9月15日に放送される前に,私たちはそれをすべて制作を完了するのにさらに数ヶ月かかりました.調査のために公衆安全データを利用する最も重要な3つの財団/機関である応用経済研究研究所 (Ipea),CICVおよびFBSPは,私の研究の結果をシェアすることを私に求めたので,この問題に関する将来の研究を行うことが役立ちます.実際,Ipeaは警察の犠牲者に関する研究を開始しています. 最後に,警察官 (特に下層階級の警察官) と軍団の医療従事者は,警察官と社会に心理的な支援が欠けているという偏見と損害を非難し,その仕事を継続するよう奨励されました. 軍事内での禁忌の話題を明らかにし,職場での心理的支援を求める多くの警察官の偏見を非難することも重要でした. また,ブラジルの一部州の取り組みも示しています.

2020-s-0211.summary: Our story unveiled, for the first time, nationwide detection of pesticides in the drinking water. Using the Brazilian freedom of information act, we had access to a public database and discovered that the Brazilian water is broadly tested positive for 27 pesticides (11 of which banned in Brazil and 21 in the European Union). It was the first time this information was made public. Our feature-story reports on nationwide contamination and our interactive map allows city level searches pointing out concentrations above the Brazilian safety limit (where standards are considered flexible) and concentrations that breached the European Union standard (world's
2020-s-0211.impact: This publication had unprecedented repercussions and the impact is still being measured: - Water companies were called to explain the data from our map by city councils across the country; - Public audiences specifically about our findings were held in the state of Minas Gerais; - Our team received an invitation to be part of a public audience held in the Brazilian Congress in order to present the information investigated and debate measures of transparency; - Two public defenders opened investigations about the presence of pesticide in the water of their cities based on information unveiled by our publication; - Large cities, such as Brasília, the country capital, had never sent the results of their tests to Ministry of Health (database manager). After being held accountable, water companies promised to be more transparent about the result of their tests. We are still following this story. - The impacts were, in many cases, on a local level, but it was a direct result of the map repercussions: we tracked over 400 local news-stories (Internet, radio and TV) about pesticides in the water quoting our investigation or map as source. For over a month after the publication, our team answered calls, emails and helped local reporters who were following our investigation to write about their region. The impact was a result of the repercussions in national and international media. Our original news-feature became the headline of the country's second largest news webportal UOL (https://noticias.uol.com.br/reportagens-especiais/coquetel-com-agrotoxicos-esta-presente-na-agua-de-1-a-cada-4-municipios/#tematico-3) and was republished by Exame magazine (https://exame.abril.com.br/brasil/1-em-4-municipios-tem-coquetel-com-agrotoxicos-na-agua-consulte-o-seu/). At least 3 international media outlets published stories about our findings quoting our investigation as source: - Telesur (South America): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfE0dJjb5IE&feature=youtu.be - The Guardian (UK): https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/26/brazil-finds-worrying-levels-of-pesticides-in-water-of-1400-towns - CGTN (China): https://america.cgtn.com/2019/05/12/water-contaminated-by-pesticides-causes-fear-in-brazil The findings were also published as part of a broader report by Public Eye on hazardous pesticides: https://www.publiceye.ch/fileadmin/doc/Pestizide/2019_PublicEye_Highly-hazardous-profits_Report.pdf
2020-s-0211.authors: Ana Aranha, Laurent Gaberell, Sylvain Lesage, Carla Hoinkes, Luana Rocha, Babak Fakhamzadeh
2020-s-0211.summaryJa: 私たちの話では初めて,飲料水における農薬の全国の検出が明らかになりました.ブラジル情報の自由法を利用して,公共データベースにアクセスし,ブラジル水では27の農薬が検出されたことが明らかになりました (11つがブラジルで禁止され,EUでは21つが禁止されています).この情報は初めて公開されました. ブラジルの安全制限を超えた濃度 (標準が柔軟性があると考えられる) と欧州連合の基準 (世界標準) を破った濃度 (世界標準) を示す都市レベルの検索を可能にします
2020-s-0211.impactJa: この出版は前例のない影響をもたらし,影響はまだ測定されています. - 水産会社は,全国の市議会によって私たちの地図からのデータを説明するために呼び出された. - 発見について具体的に,ミナスジェライス州で公開された. - 私たちのチームは,調査された情報を提示し,透明性の対策を議論するために,ブラジル議会で開催された公開の聴衆の一部になるよう招待を受けました. - 2つの公的デフォ都市では,私たちの出版物によって公開された情報に基づいて,農薬の存在に関する調査を開始しました. - ブラジリアのような都市は,国の首都は,健康省 (データベース管理者) に検査結果を送ったことはありませんでした. 責任を取られた後,水産企業は,検査結果についてより透明性を有すると約束しました. 私たちはまだこの話を続いています. - 影響は多くの場合地方レベルでしたが地図の影響の直接的な結果でした.私たちは調査や地図を源として引用した水中の農薬に関する400以上の地元のニュース (インターネット,ラジオ,テレビ) を追跡しました. 発表後1ヶ月以上,私たちのチームは電話やメールに答え,調査をフォローしていた地元の記者たちに地域について書くのを手伝いました. 影響は国内および国際メディアでの影響の結果でした. 当初のニュース機能は,国の第2位のニュースウェブポートアル UOL (https://noticias.uol.com.br/reportagens-especiais/coquetel-com-agrotoxicos-esta-presente-na-agua-de-1-a-cada-4-municipios/#tematico-3) の見出しとなり,Exame誌 (https://exame.abril.com.br/brasil/1-em-4-municipios-tem-coquetel-com-otoxicos-na-agua-consulte-o-seu/) によって再発行されました. 海外のメディアは少なくとも3つの記事に我々の調査結果を引用した. ソースとして: - テレスル (南米): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfE0dJjb5IE&feature=youtu.be - The Guardian (イギリス): https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/26/Brazil-finds-worry-level-of-pesticides-in-water-of-1400-towns - CGTN (中国): https://america.cgtn.com/2019/05/12/water-contaminated-by-pesticides-causes-fear-in-brazil 発見は,また,パラジルの名義で公開された. 危険性のある農薬に関するPublicEyeのより広範な報告書の t: https://www.publiceye.ch/fileadmin/doc/Pestizide/2019_PublicEye_Highly-hazardous-profits_Report.pdf

2020-s-0212.summary: Funes is an algorithm that identifies corruption risk situations in publics contractings in Peru. The research project began to take shape in February 2018 and its development began in September of the same year. For 15 months a multidisciplinary team - integrated by programmers, statisticians and journalists - discussed, analyzed, built databases, verified the information and developed modeled an algorithm we call Funes, as the memorable protoganist of the Argentine writer Jorge Luis Borges. The algorithm rates a risk score for each contract process, entity and company. With that information journalists can prioritize their investigations.
2020-s-0212.impact: The project was developed in the context of the fiscal investigations of the Lavajato case, which involves the payment of bribes by the Brazilian company Odebrecht in order to take charge of public contracts for the construction of public works. FUNES analyzes the contracts, and during its launch, identified a huge number of contracts with corruption risks. Of these, several were investigated and transformed into published reports. FUNES is the first tool developed in Peru, and one of the first of its kind in Latin America, which analyzes millions of data, to grant a corruption risk score in public procurement. FUNES identified that between 2015 and 2018 the Peruvian State granted almost 20 billion dollars in risky contracts. These were delivered to a single bidder who had no competition and to companies created a few days before the contest. The amount represents 90 times the civil reparation that Odebrecht must pay for its acts of corruption. Other published reports identified acts of corruption in companies that sell milk for social programs. The tool has a friendly interface for readers with several visualizations in which the reader can analyze the situation of public contracts in Peru. The open source tool has attracted the interest of the control and control entities of Peru, who have requested to share the methodology and possibilities so that they can implement it in their equipment. FUNES warns of risk in thousands of contracts. Therefore, and given the dimension of the findings, OjoPúblico established alliances with regional media to analyze and investigate some of the main cases. Everyone noticed the same thing: irregular public contracts that have now begun to be investigated by the authorities. The investigations continue.
2020-s-0212.authors: Gianfranco Rossi, Nelly Luna Amancio, Gianfranco Huamán, Ernesto Cabral, Óscar Castilla
2020-s-0212.summaryJa: Funesはペルーの公共契約における腐敗リスク状況を特定するアルゴリズムである.研究プロジェクトは2018年2月に形作られ,同年の9月に開発を開始した. アルゼンチン作家ホルヘ・ルイス・ボルゲスの記憶に残る原始学者として15ヶ月間,プログラマー,統計学者,ジャーナリストが統合された多学科的なチームは,データベースを議論し,分析し,データベースを構築し,情報を検証し,モデル化されたアルゴリズムを開発しました. アルゴリズムは,各契約プロセス,企業,企業に対するリスクスコアを評価します.その情報を使ってジャーナリストは調査を優先することができます.
2020-s-0212.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,公共事業建設の公共契約を担当するためにブラジル企業オデブレクトが賄賂を支払ったラバジャト事件の財政調査の背景に開発された.FUNESは契約を分析し,開始中に腐敗リスクのある膨大な数の契約を特定した.そのうちいくつかは調査され,公表された報告に変換された. FUNESはペルーで開発された最初のツールであり,ラテンアメリカでも数百万ものデータを分析し,公共調達における腐敗リスクスコアを与える最初のツールです.FUNESは,2015年から2018年の間にペルー政府はリスクの高い契約でほぼ20億ドルを支払ったことを確認しました.これらは競争に欠けていた単一の投標者に配達され,コンテストの数日前に設立された企業に配達されました. この金額は,オデブレクトが腐敗行為に対して支払うべき民事賠償額の90倍である.他の公表された報告では,社会プログラムのために牛乳を売る企業における腐敗行為が特定された.このツールには,読者向けの友好的なインターフェースがあり,読者がペルーの公共契約状況を分析できるいくつかのビジュアライゼーションがあります. オープンソースツールによりペルーの制御および制御機関が興味を惹きつけ,その方法論と可能性を共有して,その設備に実装できるようにしました.FUNESは数千の契約にリスクがあると警告しています.したがって,結果の大きさを考慮して,OjoPúblicoは,いくつかの主要なケースを分析し,調査するために地域メディアと提携を結んだ. 違法な公共契約が当局の調査に続いており捜査は継続しています

2020-s-0213.summary: Two of every ten of killings in Mexico, between 2007 and 2018, were young Mexicans (15-24 years); only in this period have been murdered 59,779. But the problem, it´s more huge: in three years (2007 to 2011) the homicide rate of this population, it tripled and showed a terrific number: 29 murders per 100 thousand young people. This was the proof of extreme violence and it was considered scandalous, but the new trends show violence that is surpassing any existing record. For the experts, the main reason for this is the lack of justice and corruption in Mexico.
2020-s-0213.impact: At the media in Mexico is very difficult to create a multimedia product, but with this microsite, we achieved an entire product to engage users and explain in different forms a difficult phenomenon. Besides, the analysis help to understand what happened in each state of Mexico and this type of product is not common in Mexico media. We were mentioned by the Global Investigative Journalism Network community (GJIN) as one of the best data journalism investigations published during that week (August 12, 2019) both for the visualizations and for the analysis that had been done of the homicides of young people in Mexico. Also, the work was republished by more than five electronic media in the country.
2020-s-0213.authors: Jetzabel Daniela Guazo, Iñigo Arredondo, Daniel Gómez, Melissa Amezcua, Valente Rosas, Miguel Garnica
2020-s-0213.summaryJa: 2007年から2018年の間にメキシコで10人のうち2人はメキシコの若者 (15~24歳) でした.この期間だけでも59,779人が殺害されました. しかし問題はさらに大きいです.この人口の殺人率は3年間で (2007~2011) 3倍になり,驚くべき数字を示しました. 専門家によるとメキシコの正義と腐敗が欠けているのがその主な原因です
2020-s-0213.impactJa: メキシコのメディアではマルチメディア製品を作るのは非常に難しいが,このマイクロサイトで,私たちはユーザーを巻き込ませて,様々な形で難しい現象を説明するための製品全体を達成しました.また,分析はメキシコの各州で何が起こったのか理解するのに役立ちます.このタイプの製品にはメキシコのメディアでは一般的ではありません. グローバル捜査ジャーナリズムネットワーク (GJIN) コミュニティは 2019 年 8 月 12 日 (日) に掲載された最高のデータジャーナリズム調査の一つとして,メキシコの若者の殺人事件の視覚化と分析のために言及しました.また,この研究は,国内で 5 以上の電子メディアによって再刊行されました.

2020-s-0214.summary: JUDGIT!...this database allows users to look up how the Japanese national budget is being spent. This is available for free, everyone can use it, and it can be useful to investigate journalism. The data we have parsed is available as open data.
2020-s-0214.impact: Using this database, we can investigate the actual flow of government money, and find the misuse of the fund. The best part of this DB is that we can look into who and what the money was spent for, not just the amount of the budget. For example, we examined by focusing on the special account for Fukushima reconstruction. Search “Special Account for Recovery from the Great East Japan Earthquake” and we found there were “16 reconstruction projects” in “Ministry of Defense”.
2020-s-0214.authors: Hideaki Kimura, Kyosuke Aragane, Makoto Watanabe, Masahiko Akimoto, Naoki Kikuchi, Shin Ito, Shun Tanaka, Yosuke Onoue, Yuichi Yazaki, Yuko Ryu, Yuta Nagayoshi
2020-s-0214.summaryJa: JUDGIT!...このデータベースは,ユーザーが日本の国民予算がどのように費やされているかを調べることができる.これは無料で,誰もが利用できます.そしてジャーナリズムを調査するのに有用な可能性があります.
2020-s-0214.impactJa: このデータベースを使用して,政府の資金の実際の流れを調査し,資金の悪用を見つけることができます.このDBの最良の部分は,予算の額だけでなく,誰が,何をお金を使ったかを調べることができるということです.例えば,福島復興のための特別口座に焦点を当てて調べました. 検索 <unk>東日本大震災からの回復のための特別口座<unk> そして,国防省の<unk>16の復興プロジェクト<unk>があったことがわかりました.

2020-s-0216.summary: Portal KRIK published an investigation about Predrag Mali, brother of Serbian Finance Minister Sinisa Mali, which discovered and documented that Predrag is using an expensive car owned by “Millennium Team “, private company engaged in numerous state-funded projects. (One of those projects is famous and controversial “Belgrade Waterfront”.) Apart from the car, KRIK found that Predrag was also using the apartment owned by this company, in which his previous girlfriend has lived. Experts agreed that such relationship between individuals (close to people in power) and private companies can be interpreted as a classic example of corruption.
2020-s-0216.impact: KRIK couldn't imagine that this story will be turned into one of the biggest smear campaigns against its team. Only few hours after the story about Predrag Mali was out, pro-regime tabloid „Serbian Telegraph“ started publishing fabricated information about KRIK. They claimed that KRIK’s journalist was "following and harassing Predrag Mali’s wife and their baby". As an “evidence” the tabloid published a video of an unknown man walking in front of Mali’s building, but that man clearly was not one of KRIK’s reporters. This was serious and well-organized attack, aimed to discredit KRIK and to distract the public attention from the discovery about minister’s brother. At the same time, Serbian top state officials like Prime Minister Brnabic and President Vucic made very irresponsible statements regarding this case, they were ignoring the discovered corruption and started claiming that KRIK is on “tabloid level”. In an incredible turn of events, Serbian police have issued award of 5.000$ to anyone who identifies the person shown in the video allegedly following Mali’s wife. This was unprecedented abuse of institutions, because Serbian police was not announcing this kind of awards even in serious cases of political assassinations, but now it did, in supporting the tabloid spin effect. Two weeks later, at KRIK’s insistence, prosecution revealed that the person from that video was actually some random passerby with the initials N.A. This story has attracted national attention, but since Serbia is captured state and public institutions (such as Anti-Corruption Agency and Prosecution) are under control of the ruling political party, there has not been adequate legal consequences against the minister so far.
2020-s-0216.summaryJa: セルビアの財務大臣のシニサ・マリの兄であるプレドラグ・マリに関する調査をポータルKRIKが発表した.この調査でプレドラグが,多くの国営プロジェクトに携わる民間企業である"ミレニアムチーム"の所有物である高価な車を使用していることが判明し,記録された. (そのプロジェクトの一つは有名な論争の的になっている. 自動車のほか,KRIKはプレドラグが前女友が住んでいたこの会社のアパートも利用していたことを発見した.専門家らは,個人 (権力者に近い人々) と民間企業との間のそのような関係が腐敗の典型的な例として解釈できると合意した.
2020-s-0216.impactJa: KRIKは,このニュースが彼のチームに対する最大の誹謗中傷キャンペーンの一つに変わることを想像できなかった.プレドラグ・マリのニュースが公開されたわずか数時間後,政権支持のタブロイドのセルビア・テレグラフは,クリクについて偽造された情報を公開し始めた.彼らは,クリクのジャーナリストが"プレドラグ・マリの妻と赤ちゃんをフォローし,嫌がらせている"と主張した. 証拠として,タブロイドは,不明の男性がマリの建物の前を歩いている動画を公開したが,明らかにその男はクリクの記者の一人ではなかった.これは,クリクを誹謗中傷し,大臣の兄弟についての発見から公衆の注意を逸らすために,深刻な組織的な攻撃であった. 同時期に,セルビアの首相ブルノビックとウチチ大統領などのトップ国家関係者は,この事件に関して非常に無責任な発言をした.彼らは明らかにされた腐敗を無視し,KRIKが"タブロイドレベル"にあると主張し始めた. セルビア警察は政治暗殺事件でもこのような賞金を発表していなかったため,前例のない制度の虐待であった.しかし,今,タブロイドスピン効果を支持して発表しました. この話は全国の注意を引いたが,セルビアが占領され,国家機関 (反腐敗機関や検察など) が支配政党の支配下にあるため,大臣に対する十分な法的影響はこれまで発生していない.

2020-s-0217.summary: For the first time, data research has been used to chart the speculation in "hot land" in the Netherlands. Small pieces of agricultural land were sold, with the assumption to be allocated for building purposes. If that happens the value of the land will rise enormously. Last years 2300 hectares of agricultural land has been cut up in 27.000 small pieces. More than ten thousand people bought these pieces and invested an estimated € 700 million. But our research showed that not a single piece of "hot land" has been allocated for building. In fact, municipalities suffer from this fragmentation.
2020-s-0217.impact: Besides media attention and parliamentary questions, the biggest impact of the publications are court cases. A lot of buyers of "hot land" think they are scammed by the traders who sold them the pieces of land. They sometimes paid €250 per m2 while the agricultural price is €8 per m2 or even less. Several sold pastures are not even fit for building purposes, since they are too close to highways or assigned as breeding grass fields for birds. The need for trading licenses are part of these court cases. Previously, The Dutch Authority for Financial Markets (AFM) supervised the market for land speculation. Several traders were given fines since they did not have the right license. Nowadays, the AFM is not involved in supervising of land trading. Traders found a loophole in the trade laws and laws for the protection of retail investors. This research sheds light on the massive use and scope of this loophole that surprised several national experts on land ownership.
2020-s-0217.authors: Josta van Bockxmeer, Gaby de Groot, Erik van Rein
2020-s-0217.summaryJa: 初のデータ調査でオランダの"温かい土地"に関する推測を図に描いた.小さな農地が売却され,建設目的のために割り当てられるという仮定で,その土地の価値が大きく上昇する.過去2年間で2300ヘクタール農地が27,000の小さな土地に割られた.10万人以上がこれらの土地を購入し,約70000万ユーロを投資した. しかし,我々の研究では"熱い土地"の片も建設に割り当てられていないことが示されました. 実際,自治体はこの分裂に苦しんでいます.
2020-s-0217.impactJa: メディアの注意と議会の質問に加えて,出版物の影響は裁判所の訴訟である.多くの"熱い土地"の購入者は,土地を売りつけた商人が騙されていると考えている. 時には2m2あたり250ユーロを支払ったが,農業価格は8m2またはそれ以下である.いくつかの販売された牧場は,高速道路に近いため,または鳥の繁殖草地として割り当てられているため,建設目的にも適していない. 取引許可の必要性はこれらの裁判所の訴訟の一部である.以前,オランダ金融市場管理局 (AFM) は土地の投機市場を監督していた.いくつかのトレーダーは適切なライセンスを持っていなかったため罰金を被った.現在,AFMは土地取引の監督に関与していない.トレーダーは小売投資家の保護のための貿易法と法律に漏洞を発見した. この研究ではこの漏洞の広範囲な利用と幅が明らかになり土地所有に関する複数の専門家は驚きました

2020-s-0218.summary: This project is a series of articles, data visualization, and open data about unexplained surplus on campaign funds. In Japan, all members of the Parliament must report income and expenditure in their campaign funds. However, when they have surplus as a result of income more than expenditure, they have no obligation to report the usage of the surplus. We investigated documents submitted by House of Representatives (lower house in Japan) members, and published all the data and source code for further coverages from other newsrooms.
2020-s-0218.impact: The most important impact of this project is that it revealed a large amount of surplus on campaign funds remains unexplained and unreported. We investigated documents on the 2014 election submitted by House of Representatives members. While some members appropriately reported the usage of their surplus, 268 members, nearly 6 in 10 of the total, have not disclosed how they spent the surplus. The total amount is approximately 950 million Yen ($8.7 million US) and the maximum is 27 million Yen ($251,000 US). Even some Members of the Cabinet have not disclosed usage of the surplus. This project contains articles to explain issues on related laws, and an interactive data visualization, where readers can quickly see trends in each political party or region and detailed balances of individual members. As a result, some Members of the Diet admitted that the treatment of surplus was not appropriate and revised their campaign income / expenditure report.
2020-s-0218.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,選挙戦資金の不解な余剰に関する記事,データ視覚化,オープンデータの一連のものです.日本では,すべての議会議員は選挙戦資金の収入と支出を報告しなければならない.しかし,収入が支出よりも多い結果として余剰がある場合,余剰の利用を報告する義務はありません. 代表館 (日本下院) の議員が提出した文書を調査し,他の新聞室からのさらなる報道のためにすべてのデータとソースコードを公開しました
2020-s-0218.impactJa: このプロジェクトの最も重要な影響は,選挙資金の余剰が説明されず報告されず,大きな額が明らかになったことです.我々は2014年の選挙に関する文書を調査した.衆議院議員が提出した.一部のメンバーが余剰の使用を適切に報告した一方で,総額の6割近くである268人のメンバーは余剰をどのように費やしたか明らかにしていない. 総額は約9億5千万円 (約870万米ドル) と最大額は2千7000万円 (約25万米ドル) です.内閣の一部の議員でさえ余剰の利用を明らかにしていない.このプロジェクトは,関連法律に関する問題を説明する記事を含み,インタラクティブなデータビジュアライゼーションを含み,読者は各政党や地域における傾向や個々のメンバーの詳細なバランスを迅速に見ることができる. その結果,一部の議員は余剰の処理が適切ではないと認め,選挙選挙収入/支出報告書を修正した.

2020-s-0219.summary: The national high school baseball championship is one of the most popular sports events in Japan. It is a great honor to play there for players. However, pitchers are often forced to throw far beyond the appropriate range. Referring to Pitch Smart, an American series of guidelines for youth baseball players to avoid overuse injuries, we published an infographic and an article to show how Japanese high school baseball pitchers are exposed to the risk of injury.
2020-s-0219.impact: The most important impact of this project is that it revealed high school baseball pitchers in Japan are throwing far beyond the usual range, and most of them are due to violation of a regulation of rest days. In Japan, there are no guidelines or rules on youth pitchers that limit over-pitching. Since many teams (schools) do not have enough pitchers to rotate them, the pitchers in such teams often had to pitch complete games during the tournament. In this infographic, we displayed the 10 pitchers who threw the most in this tournament after 2000, and applied two rules from Pitch Smart to their pitches. Pitches that violate the daily limit (105 pitches at the age of 17 - 18) are displayed in yellow, and pitches that violate the rest day restrictions (4 days after throwing more than 81 pitches) are displayed in red. While pitches that violate neither are displayed in white, they may still conflict with other rules of Pitch Smart. This infographic shows that high school baseball pitchers are forced to throw excessive pitches, and especially they do not have enough rest days. Since the number of teams gradually decreases later in the tournament, they often have to throw several days in a row. For instance, Yuki Saito (斎藤 佑樹), the pitcher who threw the most in this graphic, threw 948 pitches in 16 days. 88 of them violate the daily limit, and 545 of them violate the rest day limit. 553 pitches were thrown in the last 4 days, including the final and its rematch. After this project was published, this problem drew attention on traditional media such as TV and social media such as Twitter. As a result, in November 2019, Japan High School Baseball Federation decided to make rules against over-pitching for their first
2020-s-0219.summaryJa: 日本では最も人気のあるスポーツイベントの一つである. 選手のためにそこでプレーするのは大きな名誉である. しかし,投手たちはしばしば適切な範囲を超えて投げるように強制される. Pitch Smartを参照して,我々は,日本高校野球投手たちが怪我のリスクにさらされていることを示すインフォグラフィックと記事を公開しました.
2020-s-0219.impactJa: このプロジェクトの最も重要な影響は,日本の高校野球投手たちが通常の範囲を超えて投げることが明らかになったことであり,そのほとんどは休日の規制違反によるものである.日本では,オーバー投手を制限する若者投手に関するガイドラインや規則はありません.多くのチーム (学校) が投手を回すのに十分な投手を持っていないため,そのようなチームでの投手たちはしばしばトーナメント中に完全な試合を投げる必要がありました. このインフォグラフィックでは,このトーナメントで2000年以降で最も投げた10人の投手を表示し, Pitch Smartから2つのルールを彼らの投手に適用した.日々の制限を違反した投手 (105投手17歳から18歳までの年齢) は黄色で表示され,休日の制限を違反した投手 (81投手以上の投手から4日後) は赤で表示される. 違反したピッチはホワイトで表示されるが,ピッチスマートの他のルールと矛盾する可能性があります.このインフォグラフィックでは,高校野球投手が過度に投げるように強制され,特に休憩日は足りません. 例えば,このグラフィックで最も投げた投手であるYuki Saito (斎藤佑樹) は,16日間で948投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投手投その結果,2019年11月に日本高校野球連盟は,初代野球のオーバーピッチングに対するルールを作ることを決定しました.

2020-s-0220.summary: It is a news service from InfoTimes consisting of one visualization and 150-300 word story tackling issues about environment, the economy, and gender. This project was created to tackle and open a dialogue on issues that were not discussed on mainstream media. The content is mainly targeted for decision makers, academics and researchers.
2020-s-0220.impact: We take the data and simplify it for easy consumption and understanding. This familiarizes the average person with data and exposes them to different data formats and sources while training him/her on how to read and consume data. Our platform also allows the audience to have access to the data for personal use by providing them with structured data​.
2020-s-0220.authors: Nour Eltigani, Aya Nader, Ahmad AlAmrousy,
2020-s-0220.summaryJa: ニュースサービス"インフォタイムズ"は,環境,経済,ジェンダーに関する問題に取り組む1つのビジュアライゼーションと150-300語間のストーリーで構成されています.このプロジェクトは,主流メディアで議論されていない問題に取り組んで対話を開くために作成されました.コンテンツは主に意思決定者,学者と研究者にターゲットです.
2020-s-0220.impactJa: データを集めて,簡単に消費し理解できるように簡素化します.これは平均的な人にデータを熟知させ,さまざまなデータ形式と情報源に曝し,データを読み取り,消費する方法を訓練します.また,私たちのプラットフォームは,組織化されたデータを提供することで,視聴者に個人用データにアクセスできるようにします.

2020-s-0221.summary: During the period of our reporting, Lebanon witnessed numerous campaigns and advocacy calls, among which were those triumphing the Syrian cause, or advocating the conditions of refugees in Lebanon. For example, hundreds of Syrian and Lebanese activists have tweeted in the last two years under the hashtag #عرسال_تستغيث in an attempt to send a distress message about the horrid living conditions refugees endure in camps. s data-driven story revealed that more than half of the tweets included in the analysis sample rejected Syrian refugees.
2020-s-0221.impact: This story created a dialogue surrounding hate speech and the hashtag took over Twitter. The hate speech that emerged through the tweets of some politicians and public figures against Syrian refugees in Lebanon, was not limited to social media, but also turned into forms of aggression in reality. After the story was published, many became aware of the hate speech that was exercised by many politicians and this led to political change in the country. The story was later also republished in Darag ( a Lebanese media outlet) and Serag ( a Syrian media platform).
2020-s-0221.authors: Mohammad Waked, Ammar Al-Khasawneh, Abdul Rahman Al-Khader, Ahmad Rahal, Manar Abu Hassoun, Aya Nader, Mohamed Zidan, Mohamed Bassiki
2020-s-0221.summaryJa: 例えば,シリアとレバノンで難民の生活状況を擁護する活動家たちが過去2年間で #アースアル・テストギースというハッシュタグでツイートした. 分析サンプルに含まれるツイートの半分以上がシリア難民を拒絶した.
2020-s-0221.impactJa: この記事では憎悪言論をめぐる対話が生まれ,ハッシュタグがツイッターを継承した.レバノンでシリア難民に対する政治家のツイートを通じて発生した憎悪言論は,ソーシャルメディアに限定されず,現実に侵略の形態にも変身した.この記事が公開された後,多くの政治家が憎悪言論を行使したことを認識し,このことが国内政治変化をもたらした. この話は後にダラグ (レバノンメディア) とセラグ (シリアメディアプラットフォーム) で再刊行された.

2020-s-0222.summary: Our report revealed that despite having one of the most progressive legislations to eradicate sexist violence, authorities leave women in Catalonia unprotected in many cases. Among other things: • The legislation was born with less than half of the estimated economic resources it needed. • The government's data fails to detect the real dimension of violence against women. • Catalan courts grant the least number of restraining orders compared to the rest of Spain. • Public policy evaluations highlight a large amount of women who do not go to social services, despite a well-distributed network of centers.
2020-s-0222.impact: We held a press conference for the official launch project, after which the documentary appeared in all major news outlets in the region. Because the authors produced it as a public service, with a grant by the puntCAT foundation, and were not seeking any distribution deals, a few outlets adopted it as a permanent link on their homepage for months. Activist organizations reached out to share the webdoc on their networks and organized events and talks around it —eight events so far, in the six months since launch. We have produced a traditional documentary to be shown at these events, and as an alternative resource for these organizations. The agency responsible for Transparency is working on addressing some of the issues raised in our report, especially those related to the data collection and budget tracking. One of the main characters in our documentary, Nuria Balada, who was president of the Catalan Women's Institute —the interdepartmental government agency in charge of suggesting and implementing gender-focused policies— left her post two months later. Despite her long trajectory and influence in shaping the implementation of the ten-year-old Catalan law, she had been widely criticized for some of the issues the administration faces which she admitted to in our documentary. Finally, we are turning the project into a wider campaign. We are collaborating with some of the main feminist organizations to perform data-driven stunts in the March and November demonstrations (International Women's Day and International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women).
2020-s-0222.authors: Karma Peiró, Xaquín G.V., Rocío Minvielle
2020-s-0222.summaryJa: 私たちの報告によると,セクシー暴力撲滅のための最も進歩的な立法の一つであるにもかかわらず,当局は多くの場合カタルーニャの女性を保護していないことが明らかになりました. • 公的政策の評価では,社会サービスに通っていない女性が多いことが明らかになりました.
2020-s-0222.impactJa: 公開の公式企画の記者会見を開催し,その後このドキュメンタリーが地域各主要新聞社に掲載されました. 執筆者はPuntCAT財団の補助金で公共サービスとして制作し,配布契約を求めたわけではないので,数メディアは数ヶ月間ホームページに永久リンクとして採用しました. 活動家組織は,Webdocをネットワークで共有し,活動と会話を組織し,その周りに発表から6ヶ月間にわたり,これまで8つのイベントを開催しました.これらのイベントで展示される伝統的なドキュメンタリー映画を制作し,これらの組織のための代替資源として利用しています.透明性担当機関は,我々の報告書で提起されたいくつかの問題,特にデータ収集と予算追跡に関連する問題に取り組んでいます. 文書の主要キャラクターの一つであるヌリア・バラダは,カタルーニャの女性研究所の社長だった. 女性の性別を中心とした政策の提案と実施を担当する政府機関である. 文書の10年後のカタルーニャ法の実施を形作る上で長い経路と影響力があったにもかかわらず,彼女は,私たちのドキュメンタリーで認めた政府が直面するいくつかの問題のために広く批判されていた. 最後に,私たちはプロジェクトをより広範なキャンペーンに変えています. 私たちは主要なフェミニスト組織と協力して,3月と11月のデモ (国際女性デーと国際女性に対する暴力撲滅の日) にデータに基づくストーンを実行しています.

2020-s-0223.summary: Bangladesh had faced a major threat following outbreak of dengue fever during August-September. The mosquito-borne dengue fever has claimed 75 lives and infected over 85,000 persons, mostly in Dhaka. We used the drone technology to capture data relating the breeding place of aedes mosquito. The result was huge. Some 36000 potential sources were identified. it was not possible manually as Dhaka city has huge rooftop gardens and its buildings built were not in planned way. The authorities were convinced by the result and they showed their interest to conduct more such use of drone technology to capture the data.
2020-s-0223.impact: The peoples were aware of the sources of the Aedes mosquito which has been killing hundreds of people of the country for long. The authorities concerned also came know about the potential sources and they are now considering conducting a large survey trough the technology. Different newspaper and TV channels also later presented news on the matter This has human welfare impact.
2020-s-0223.authors: Md zahid Hasan SIddiquee, Sazid Ibn Zaman and Jasim Uddin Haroon
2020-s-0223.summaryJa: バングラデシュは8月から9月にデング熱が流行した後に大きな脅威に直面していた.蚊によるデング熱は75人の命を奪い,大抵はダカで85,000人を感染した.我々は無人機技術を使って,エデス蚊の繁殖地に関するデータを捕捉した.結果は巨大だった.約36,000の潜在的な源が特定された.ダカ市には巨大な屋上庭があり,建物は計画通りに建設されていないため,手動で不可能だった. 報告結果に納得して,ドローン技術の使用を拡大してデータを捕捉する意向を示した.
2020-s-0223.impactJa: 住民は,長らく何百人もの国民を殺害しているエイデス蚊の源を知っていた.関係当局も潜在的源を知った.そして,現在彼らは技術を使って大規模な調査を実施することを検討している.

2020-s-0224.summary: Anyone who had their holiday plans disrupted during runway shutdowns at Gatwick and Heathrow last winter knows the havoc drones can wreak on air travel. But did you know pilots had previously reported hundreds of near-collisions with the devices in UK skies? That’s one of the frankly alarming findings of my data-led investigation into the growing number of near-misses between drones and aircraft being reported to officials. Local versions of this story were run across dozens of JPIMedia’s regional and local news titles.
2020-s-0224.impact: I produced a story pack as part of my role running the JPIMedia Data Unit. The investigation ran in more than 60 JPIMedia titles. This included national newspaper the i, which was also one of a number of titles to run an accompanying op-ed article about the issue. Coverage across the UK included three front-page splashes, nearly 20 double-page spreads and numerous op-eds. The case studies I provided proved particularly hard-hitting. There was the paraglider in Derbyshire left terrified after an unknown drone pilot persistently flew a quadcopter just feet away from him in flight, seemingly to obtain film footage but threatening to collide with the thin canopy-to-harness lines keeping him safe. There was also the drone flown deliberately over the centre of Gatwick’s runway which nearly hit an Airbus A321 coming into land, a full three years before the chaos caused at the airport before Christmas 2018.
2020-s-0224.authors: Claire Wilde, Flourish map by Tim Hopkinson, additional reporting by Dean Kirby, Alison Bellamy
2020-s-0224.summaryJa: 飛行機が航空旅行に及ぼす被害は去年の冬のゲートウィックとヒースローの飛行場閉鎖で休暇の計画が混乱した人は誰でも知っていますが,パイロットが以前にもイギリス空に航空機と衝突したことが報告されていたことはご存知ですか? これは,当局に報告されているドローンと航空機の間近な衝突の増加に関する私のデータ主導の調査で明らかに懸念すべき発見の一つです. この記事の地元バージョンは,JPIMediaの地域と地域ニュースタイトルに載っています.
2020-s-0224.impactJa: JPIMedia Data Unitを運営する私の役割の一環として,私はストーリーパックを作成しました.調査はJPIMediaのタイトル60以上のタイトルで実行されました.この中には,国家新聞theiも含まれていました.また,この問題に関するコラボレーティング記事を運営する多くのタイトルの一つでした.英国全域の報道には,3つの前ページのスプラッシュ,ほぼ20の双ページのスプレッドと多数のオプセーディが含まれていました.私が提供したケース・スタディは特に衝撃的なことが証明されました. ダービシャーでパラグライダーが,不明のドローンパイロットが,彼の飛行からわずか3メートル離れた距離に,四角copterを飛ぶことに耐え忍び,フィルム映像を取得しようとしたが,彼を安全に保つ薄いキャノピュレットからハネスラインに衝突すると脅した.また,ドローンが故意にギャトウィークのランウェイの中心部を空中した.それは,エアバス A321が陸上を接近した3年前,クリスマスの前,空港で引き起こされた混乱から3年前に,完全に321年前に,陸上をぶつかった.

2020-s-0225.summary: To Be Precise - is a project for NGOs, businesses, journalists, and others who work with social problems in Russia. The mission of the project is to promote an analytical approach in highlighting and solving these problems by representing the reality of each problem (now we got HIV, Prisons, Оrphanhood, Crimes, and Environment for Disabled People). The project contains both open governmental data from relevant departments and data from non-governmental institutions, non-profit organizations and other alternative sources. We are working on an extension of represented social topics.
2020-s-0225.impact: NGOs started to use the project for planing their work in regions (we've received 945 mentions on social media and sites of these types of organizations). We also received 143 works of data-journalists based on our project and mentioned our impact.
2020-s-0225.authors: Elizaveta Yaznevich, Anna Arzamasova, Ksenia Babikhina, Karina Pipiya, Artem Tinchurin, Oleg Pimonov, Valeriya Mescheryakova, Andrey Melentev, Alexander Kozlov, Natalia Freik, Sofiya Savina, Kristina Zvezdova, Petr Butaev, Katerina Abramova
2020-s-0225.summaryJa: To Be Precise (To Be Precise) は,ロシアにおける社会問題に取り組むNGO,企業,ジャーナリスト,その他の人々のためのプロジェクトです. このプロジェクトの使命は,それぞれの問題の現実を表現することによって,これらの問題を解決する分析的なアプローチを推進することです (現在私たちはHIV,刑務所,孤児院,犯罪,そして障害者のための環境を得ました). このプロジェクトには関係部門からの公開政府データと非政府機関や非営利団体などの代替情報源の両方が含まれています代表社会トピックの拡張に取り組んでいます
2020-s-0225.impactJa: 地域での活動を計画するためにNGOがプロジェクトを利用し始めました (ソーシャルメディアやこのような組織のサイトで 945件の言及が寄せられました) また,プロジェクトに基づいてデータジャーナリストの 143件の作品も受信し,私たちの影響について言及しました.

2020-s-0226.summary: 80 percent of Berliners live in rented accommodation. Many of them actually do not know who owns the apartment they live in, because Germany does not have a central property register. Government officials and the civil society do not know, which property companies own apartments in Berlin. Powerful actors remain invisible and difficult to reach for political debate. The editors of Tagesspiegel and Correctiv wanted to bring more transparency to the Berlin real estate market by using crowd sourcing. The aim was to uncover problems, highlight larger structures, make grievances visible and provide a factual basis for a public debate.
2020-s-0226.impact: The research was conducted as a crowd investigation. From October 2018 onwards, tenants were able to use an online platform, to provide information on the owner of their apartment and on the experience, they have had with their landlord. In order for the entries to be verified, they were asked to submit supporting documents. Thousands of submissions were received. Starting in January 2019, the editorial offices of the Tagesspiegel Innovation Lab and Correctiv spent several months verifying each and every one of the readers' submissions, as well as evaluating background interviews, files, anonymous tips and other databases. At discussion events, they invited readers, politicians, representatives of the real estate industry and researchers to discuss the capital's housing crisis and seek solutions. Hundreds of Berliners attended. Thanks to numerous tips, the research team succeeded, for example, in uncovering the growing business model behind furnished apartments after several hints. With this model, landlords circumvent the rent brake imposed in Berlin. In the process, the journalists also came across previously unknown large property owners. The team was able to prove for the first time that a silent real estate mogul “Pears”, an English family, owning more than 3000 apartments in the city. This is an important limit for politicians in the debate about affordable housing, who until now knew nothing about this owner. Furthermore, it was uncovered in detail how the real estate and the financial markets are connected. Many tenants in Berlin have invested in residential property shares themselves via funds, without knowing it. That’s because some tenants living in an apartment of the equity real estate companies have pension plans investing their clients' money in their own landlord. The team received the German “Reporterpreis” for this investigation.
2020-s-0226.authors: Tagesspiegel Innovation Lab (Andreas Baum, Michael Gegg, Hendrik Lehmann, Michael Gegg, Helena Wittlich); Correctiv (Anne-Lise Bouyer, Justus von Daniels, Michel Penke, Simon Wörpel)
2020-s-0226.summaryJa: ベルリン人の80%が賃貸アパートに住んでいます. 実際,その多くは住んでいたアパートの所有者を知らないのですドイツには中央財産登録制度がないからです. 政府関係者や市民社会はベルリンでアパートを所有する不動産会社を知らない. 権力のある俳優は見えなく,政治議論に触れるのは難しいのです. Tagesspiegelと Correctivの編集者は,クラウドソーシングを使用してベルリン不動産市場により透明性をもたらしたいと考えました. 目的は問題を発見し,より大きな構造を強調し,苦情を目に見えるようにし,公共の議論の事実的な基盤を提供することでした.

2020-s-0227.summary: This project explores the secretive multi-billion dollar hydroelectric power agreements between China and Myanmar that will determine the future of millions of Myanmar’s impoverished citizens. The story unravels Myanmar’s broader financial entanglements with China and weaves together the limited data available to map out the future lives and livelihoods of Myanmar citizens, including indigenous communities who may be swept away in the dam floodwaters.
2020-s-0227.impact: The story was much discussed on Twitter and at events among the Southeast Asia aid community, Chinese Belt and Road Initiative scholars and regional English-language media. But the larger goal was to reach Myanmar citizens. This is the first story in a series that provides comprehensive data-driven explanatory reporting to Myanmar citizens in the Myanmar language about the long term impact of foreign investment on the country’s future, as they try to steer their way to democracy.
2020-s-0227.authors: Victoria Milko, Clare Hammond, Ye Mon, Eva Constantaras
2020-s-0227.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,ミャンマーと中国の間で数十億ドル規模の水力発電の秘密の協定を調査し,ミャンマーで暮らす何百万人もの貧しい市民の未来を決定する.この物語は,ミャンマーと中国の広範な金融関係を解き明かす.
2020-s-0227.impactJa: この話はツイッターや東南アジア支援コミュニティ,中国ベルトと道路イニシアチブ学者,および地域英語のメディアのイベントで議論されました. しかし,より大きな目標は,ミャンマー市民に届くことでした. これは,ミャンマー国民に,民主主義への道を向けるよう努力している間に,外国投資が国の未来に与える長期的な影響について,ミャンマー語で,包括的なデータ主導の説明を提供するシリーズの最初の記事です.

2020-s-0228.summary: This project is a scroll-based explainer of "partisan bias" a specific measure of how skewed an electoral map might be. Partisan bias was mentioned in the Supreme Court case on partisan gerrymandering in North Carolina and this piece first explains how the metric works using congressional elections data from the past 30 years, and then uses real historical political maps from three states to talk about some recent instances of gerrymandering and corrective maps that have been put in place as solutions.
2020-s-0228.impact: The project was well recieverd and cited by gerrymandering experts (such as creator of the efficiency gap Nicholas Stephanopoulos) as a clear explainer of a widely used metric in gerrymandering. Gerrymandered maps are notoriously hard to define (just ask the Supreme Court) but this project gives readers a clear explanation of one way to go about it.
2020-s-0228.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは "党派偏見"の説明書です選挙地図がどれほど歪んでいるかを示す具体的な指標ですこの作品は最初に議会選挙データを利用してどのように機能するか説明し,その後,解決策として導入されたいくつかの最近のジェリーマンダーや修正地図について話すために,3州の実際の歴史的政治地図を使用します.
2020-s-0228.impactJa: このプロジェクトは受付され,高性能差の創造者ニコラス・ステファノポルース (Gerrymanderingの専門家) が,高性能差の創造者ニコラス・ステファノポルース (Nicholas Stephanopoulos) といったプロジェクトが,高性能差の創造者ニコラス・ステファノポルース (Gerrymanderingの専門家) と呼ばれる.

2020-s-0229.summary: Every September, leaders from around the world gather at the United Nations in New York to debate and pass resolutions on the biggest issues facing the planet. To understand what the key issues have been over the years, Al Jazeera visualized all 6,112 roll-call votes of all 193 UN member states from 1946 to 2018. The visualization provides a decade by decade explanation of major moments in history as well as a robust exploratory feature which allows readers to discover exactly how their country voted on key issues over the entire history of the UN.
2020-s-0229.impact: This project is the largest visual analysis of the UN General Assembly. This visualization revealed several fascinating insights including how nearly one-fifth of all resolutions have been about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. This, as well as other interesting findings generated a lot of engagement with Al Jazeera’s global audience in English as well as Arabic. Since launching in September ahead of the 74<sup>th</sup> annual General Assembly the story has been viewed nearly 200,000 times and has had an average time on page of 4:11. The story has continued to generated a long tail of web readership, months after publishing and is being used in universities and schools around the world as an international relations and politics resource. Members of the UN's data and creative technologies team reached out to Al Jazeera and invited us to present the project as a new way of visualizing otherwise complex data which has a direct impact on people from all over the world.
2020-s-0229.authors: Mohammed Haddad, Usaid Siddiqui, Owais Zaheer
2020-s-0229.summaryJa: 毎年9月,世界中の指導者たちはニューヨークの国連で集まって,地球が直面する最大の問題について議論し,決議を採択します.何年もの間,重要な問題はどのようなものであったかを理解するために,アルジャジーラは1946年から2018年まで,国連加盟国193カ国全体の6,112の投票を視覚化しました. 視覚化により歴史における重要な瞬間を 10年ごとに説明し, 強力な探査機能が提供され, 読者は国連の歴史全体において国の重要な問題について投票した方法を正確に発見することができます.
2020-s-0229.impactJa: This project is the largest visual analysis of the UN General Assembly. This, as well as other interesting findings generated a lot of engagement with Al Jazeera<unk>s global audience in English as well as Arabic. 74th annual General Assemblyの9月に開始された以来,この記事は近20万回見られ,平均4ページの4時間しか持っていなかった. 国連のデータ・クリエイティブ・テクノロジーチームのメンバーがアルジャジーラに連絡しプロジェクトを複雑なデータを視覚化する新しい方法として紹介するよう招待しましたこれは世界中の人々に影響を及ぼします

2020-s-0230.summary: A fun side project to approach the annual National Day Parade in Singapore. Each year a new song is released by local artists, commissioned by the National Day Parade organising committee. We looked at all 26 songs musically to show their differences and decade trends by using the Spotify API.
2020-s-0230.impact: Reactions were very light-hearted and fun. There was a competition attached to the interactive to giveaway much coveted NDP tickets. Comments on social media were nostalgic, reminiscing about certain songs or totally forgetting about others. It was amongst our top 10 graphics for the year in pageviews.

2020-s-0230.summaryJa: シンガポールで毎年開催される全国デーパレードに近付く楽しい副プロジェクトです. 毎年,ナショナルデーパレード組織委員会が委託した地元のアーティストによって新しい曲がリリースされます. Spotify APIを使用して,すべての26曲を音楽的に見てみました.

2020-s-0231.summary: This project, published during the year Singapore celebrated its bicentennial in 2019, takes a look at how the country’s past is quietly preserved in the names of its streets. For a country which doubled the number of its streets in just half a century, the names reveal throwbacks to British colonial times, a stunning array of Malay words and other surprising references. The data for this was manually compiled from various resources, including two books publishing on the topic. Over 3,500 streets were classified, geolocated and individually checked to create this data-driven lifestyle story.
2020-s-0231.impact: This project was shared by many on social media, particularly amongst the local heritage community. The authors of the two books used in this project were overwhelmed by the visualisation of their work. They have asked us if they can include links to this project in upcoming reprints of their books. This project appeals to anyone who lives in Singapore or who has an interest in Singapore’s history, and it will serve as a reference piece for years to come.
2020-s-0231.authors: Aloysius Tan, Alyssa Karla Mungcal, Bessa Nicoletta, Goh Yan Han, Hannah Yan, Lee Sujin, Raihanah Ruslan, Rebecca Pazos, Trinity Tan and Yu Sheng Sin.
2020-s-0231.summaryJa: 2019年にシンガポールが200周年を記念した年に発表されたこのプロジェクトは,街頭名において国の過去が静かに保存されている方法について考察しています.わずか半世紀で街頭数を倍にした国にとって,名前はイギリス植民地時代への追溯,驚くべきマレーシア語の配列,その他の驚くべき参照を明らかにしています. このデータに関するデータは,このテーマに関する2冊の本を掲載したほか,様々なリソースから手動で収集された.このデータに基づくライフスタイルストーリーを作成するために3,500以上の通りを分類し,地理位置と個別的にチェックした.
2020-s-0231.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,特に地元の遺産コミュニティーによって,ソーシャルメディアで多くの人々が共有しました.このプロジェクトで使用された2本の本の著者は,作品の視覚化に圧倒されました.彼らは,このプロジェクトへのリンクを本書の再印刷に含めることができるかどうか尋ねました.このプロジェクトはシンガポールに住んでいるすべての人に訴えます.またはシンガポールの歴史に興味があるすべての人に,そしてそれは今後数年間参考文献として機能します.

2020-s-0232.summary: "FORCED OUT" tells the story of forced displacement in South Sudan following years of civil war. Al Jazeera used an innovative mobile phone survey to measuring the scale of the conflict in South Sudan. We dialled more than 35,000 random phone numbers to paint an accurate picture of land rights and forced displacement across the entire country. The data collection reached people nationwide and provided us access to people who are in rural areas, in opposition territory, currently displaced, and who are illiterate. No other organisation had ever collected land rights data on this scale.
2020-s-0232.impact: To our knowledge this is the most comprehensive data-driven look at the situation in South Sudan. While the data provides necessary context, the human stories are what made this story resonate with our global audience. The story generated a lot of discussion about how land rights are important in the context of the current peace agreement, including from analysts, land rights experts, diplomats and academics. As well, the page views were quite high for such a project: 110,000 page views, and 4:42 average time on the page, 70% from mobile devices.
2020-s-0232.authors: Carolyn Thompson, Kristen van Schie, Lagu Joseph Jackson, Thomas Holder, Anealla Safdar, and Mohammed Haddad
2020-s-0232.summaryJa: "FORCED OUT"は南スーダンで長年にわたる内戦の後,南スーダンで強制移住の話をします.アルジャジーラは南スーダンでの紛争の規模を測定するために革新的な携帯電話調査を使用しました.我々は35,000以上のランダムな電話番号をダイヤルして,全国の土地権利と強制移住の正確なイメージを描きました. 国民全体にデータ収集が届き, 反対派地域, 現地に移住し,文盲者の人々へのアクセスを提供しました. この規模で土地権に関するデータを他の組織は収集したことがありませんでした.
2020-s-0232.impactJa: 韓国における状況に関する最も包括的なデータに基づく見方です.データによって必要な文脈が提供されているが,人間の物語は,この物語を世界の観客に響かせたものです.この物語は,分析家,土地権利専門家,外交官,学者の間で,現在の平和協定の文脈で土地権利がいかに重要かについての多くの議論を招きました. ページの閲覧数は 11万回でページの平均時間は4時42分で 70%はモバイルデバイスからでした

2020-s-0233.summary: Think it’s tough fighting for a spot in prestigious colleges? In Singapore, the competition starts at primary, or elementary, schools. The process is competitive, with many having to ballot for entry at various stages of the registration process to the most popular schools. Based on data from the past 13 years, we build a machine learning model to predict the risk of over-subscription. And, to make it engaging for our readers, we allow them to simulate this process many times with our simulation tool.
2020-s-0233.impact: This interactive is a popular graphic, going beyond providing information to readers that would normally be conveyed in a typical article format to become a valuable, reusable widget for parents to get an idea of the chances of their child gaining entry to a school of their choice at each phase of the registration process. Engagement is high for this interactive, with average time on page reaching over 5 minutes, easily doubled the site's average.
2020-s-0233.authors: Jocelyn Tan, Lee Pei Jie, Rebecca Pazos and Thong Yong Jun.
2020-s-0233.summaryJa: シンガポールでは,初等学校から競争が始まる.このプロセスは競争的である.多くの方が最も人気のある学校への登録の様々な段階で入学のために投票しなければならない.過去13年のデータに基づいて,私たちは過剰登録のリスクを予測するために機械学習モデルを構築しました. 読み手にとって魅力的なものにするために試算ツールを使って何度もこのプロセスを模倣できるようにします
2020-s-0233.impactJa: このインタラクティブは,一般的には典型的な記事形式で伝達される情報を読者に提供する以上の人気のあるグラフィックであり,親が登録プロセスの各段階で自分の子供が自分の選択の学校に入学する可能性について考えられるために価値のある,再利用可能なウィジェットになる.このインタラクティブには平均的なページ時間は5分を超え,サイトの平均を簡単に倍にする.

2020-s-0234.summary: The Ecumenic Creative Operations (https://ecumenic.github.io) is developing an extense open-source research of the laic and faith-inspired creative industry ecosystem (https://bit.do/ecumenic-ecosystem). With its community of agents and scenario indicators data they look after improving its production reliability engineering technologies, regenerativity ecology, sustainable economy, and ecumenical laic-interfaith diplomacy development. From the analysis of this information, as presented in their project (https://bit.do/ecumenic-project) they global charters compliance (https://bit.do/ecumenic-compliance), dignified inclusivity accessibility code of conduct (https://bit.do/ecumenic-conduct) collaboration guidelines (https://bit.do/ecumenic-collaboration), contract template (https://bit.do/ecumenic-contract). These and other materials (https://github.com/ecumenic/project) are available for use from any faith-inspired or laic cultural development organizations under the Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-SA-4.1 license
2020-s-0234.impact: The enterprise open-community is developing a set of data-ethics policies from this research of extreme importance for world community, such as a global standards charters compliance commitment (https://bit.do/ecumenic-compliance), a dignified inclusivity accessibility entrepeneurial code of conduct (https://bit.do/ecumenic-conduct), an open-source devops collaboration guidelines (https://bit.do/ecumenic-collaboration), a fair-trade contract template (https://bit.do/ecumenic-contract), and an open-educational-resource (OER) on total-artwork operatic ecomuseology cultural development artscraft production modular instruction program (https://bit.do/ecumenic-ecomuseology) which are also available for any peacebuilding compliant faith-inspired or laic cultural development organizations under the Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-SA-4.1 license (https://bit.do/ecumenic-license). With this we have been able to collaborate with many communities such as craftspeople, seekers gatherings, animals, cinema sets staffs, artistic collectives, theatre and dance companies, archiengineers, indigenous tribes and nations, street marketers, infrastructure developers, rule-of-law settlements, jail population (jailers included), pregnants, plants, midwives, business developers, neurodiverses, psychonauts, scholars, policemen, transqueers, homeless and landless people, civil movements, grafitti crews, legislators, landscapers, semiotic multimedia researchers, cleaners, fablabs, seniors schools, physicians, carers, urban renewal ngo's, open-software communities, cosmoethicians, broiderers, metarecyclers, independent medias, farmers and herdsmen, street marketers, scientists, sustainable intentional communities, human-rights advocates, research residencists, social bankers, among other euthenic oriented people our whole gratitude.
2020-s-0234.summaryJa: グローバル・クリエイティブ・オペレーションズ (https://ecumenic.github.io) は,世俗と信仰にインスピレーションを受けた創造産業エコシステム (https://bit.do/ecumenic-ecosystem) の広範なオープンソース研究を開発しています. 代理人コミュニティとシナリオ指標データにより,彼らは生産信頼性エンジニアリング技術,再生可能エコロジー,持続可能な経済,世俗と世俗の宗教間外交開発の改善を重視しています. この情報の分析から,彼らのプロジェクト (https://bit.do/ecumenic-project) で提示されたように,彼らはグローバルチャーターの遵守 (https://bit.do/ecumenic-compliance),尊厳ある包摂性アクセシビリティの行動規範 (https://bit.do/ecumenic-conduct) 協力ガイドライン (https://bit.do/ecumenic-collaboration),契約テンプレート (https://bit.do/ecumenic-contract) を確認しました. これらの資料およびその他の資料 (https://github.com/ecumenic/project) は,Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-SA-4.1ライセンスの下で信仰を鼓舞するまたは世俗的な文化開発団体から利用可能です.
