2020-s-0417.summary: Part of a package to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the May 13 deadly riots, this multimedia project features a blow-by-blow account of what happened on the first day of communal riots of 1969 which changed the direction of Malaysia. It tackles this taboo topic by locating the incidents of the riot onto an interactive contemporary map of Kuala Lumpur, giving the reader a visceral experience anchored on geographical and archival data, plus corroborated eye witness accounts. It also sets the context and consequence to explain how this riot is pivotal in Malaysian history.
2020-s-0417.impact: This project was part of a series of articles on the May 13 riots. The package received million page pageviews, while the microsite (submitted here) received 307,831 pageviews and about 43,000 social media shares in the first fornight. This is at least three times more than other special reports we produce. It generated a record number of new subscribers. The project forced a national conversation, especially among the younger generations who live with the taboo of May 13, but were barred discussing it. Young people told us it was first time they were learning about the riots in detail because it is not taught in school due to 'sensitivities'. Three US-based researchers contacted us to include our work in their research. We were invited to speak about it at journalist events and on television. About 100 people - mostly under 35 - attended our intergenerational discussion between eye witnesses (including one who was a police officer at the time) and young Malaysians. One of the eye witnesses died soon after, a poignant reminder of how important it was that his recollections were recorded. The forum was guarded by police as some conservative groups threatened to disrupt it. This, however, did not materialise. Because the narrative of May 13 is so contested, our journalists received online attacks and had to lodged a police report after safety threats. The page also featured a call-out to witnesses to share their May 13 stories. They submitted stories through Google forms, email, social media and through phone calls to the newsroom. We closed submissions on June 13, 2019. A total 42, which we could corroborate, were published on a linked page (https://pages.malaysiakini.com/may13/stories/), as a popular archive of the event. The National Archives told us it was also including the project into its collection.
2020-s-0417.authors: Aidila Razak, Lee Long Hui, Sean Ho, Thiaga Raj, Tham Seen Hau, Wong Kai Hui, M Fakhrull Halim, Annabelle Lee
2020-s-0417.summaryJa: マレーシアが1969年の暴動をきっかけに起きた最初の日に起こった出来事についてマルチメディアプロジェクトが紹介されています. このタブーテーマをクアラルンプールのインタラクティブな現代地図に暴動事件を位置づけ,地理的およびアーカイブデータに固定された内心的な体験を与え,裏付けされた目撃者説明も提供しています.また,この暴動がマレーシアの歴史においてどのように重要なかを説明するための文脈と結果も設定しています.
2020-s-0417.impactJa: このプロジェクトは5月13日の暴動に関する一連の記事の一部でした.パッケージは100万ページビューを受賞し,マイクロサイト (こちらを投稿する) は最初の夜間に307,831ページビューと43,000のソーシャルメディアシェアを獲得しました.これは,私たちが作成する他の特別レポートよりも少なくとも3倍多くです.新しいサブスクライアントの記録的な数を生み出しました. このプロジェクトは,特に5月13日のタブーで生活する若い世代の中で,全国的な会話を強要したが,議論は禁止された.若者は,それは"敏感性"のために学校で教えられていないため,暴動について詳細に学ぶのは初めてだと教えてくれました.米国に拠点を置く3人の研究者が,我々の研究に私たちの研究を組み込むために हमसे連絡を取った.我々はジャーナリストイベントやテレビでそのことについて話すように招待された. 目の目撃者 (当時警察官だった一人を含む) と若いマレーシア人の間で世代間での議論に参加した人数は約100人でした. 目撃者の1人がすぐに亡くなった. 彼の記憶が記録されたことがどれほど重要であったかを感銘を受けた.いくつかの保守派集団が混乱すると脅迫したため,フォーラムは警察によって守られていた.しかし,これは実現しなかった. 5月13日の物語は非常に議論されているため,我々のジャーナリストはオンライン攻撃を受け,安全脅迫を受けて警察報告を提出しなければならなかった.ページには目撃者が5月13日の物語を共有するよう呼び出され,彼らはGoogleフォーム,メール,ソーシャルメディア,電話を通じてニュースルームに話を提出しました.我々は2019年6月13日に投稿を終了しました. 関連ページ (https://pages.malaysiakini.com/may13/stories/) で,このイベントの人気アーカイブとして合計42件が公開されました.

2020-s-0418.summary: The pollution blighting rivers across the UK was revealed in an exclusive data-driven investigation that led the Environment Agency to reveal it was reassessing long-term targets. Our analysis found around eight in ten waterways were not in good health, prompting the WWF charity to say they were being treated as “open sewers”, and failed to meet environmental standards. And we showed that despite this challenge, the government was still predicting that three quarters would be in good health by 2027. Commenting on the findings, the Green Party co-leader Jonathan Bartley said the state of our rivers was “totally unacceptable”.
2020-s-0418.impact: The Environment Agency said it would now review the targets "based on what can realistically be achieved". The research led to coverage across BBC News platforms, with environmental charities, campaigners and academics highlighting the issue of river pollution. It showed the UK was a long way from meeting targets it had set itself as part of Europe-wide efforts to improve the health of rivers. WWF media manager Lis Speight said: "Without such investigative journalism, important stories that lie buried in dense data would simply not be told. The team behind this piece were meticulous, really diving down into the numbers and spending time to really understand this issue and to get their facts straight." The BBC's Head of UK News Richard Burgess said: "This was an important piece of public interest reporting on a topic that needed investigation and discussion. Through the data journalism that went into analysing, visualising and presenting the figures our programmes were able to tell compelling stories about the challenges facing England’s waterways that would otherwise have remained hidden in plain sight." We invited questions from readers using an online form and answered those questions, inserting responses into the piece. The questions showed we had got people thinking about the waters they swim in and what they could do to make a difference, whether that was reporting a pollution incident or joining a group or charity that would work to improve the ecological health of waters. Our dataset was shared across the BBC with journalists on TV and radio so that they could identify stretches of river that were in poor health and use that for filming, location two-ways etc.
2020-s-0418.summaryJa: 汚染による河川の汚染は,英国全域でのデータに基づく調査で明らかになった.この調査で環境庁は長期的な目標を再評価していることが明らかになった.我々の分析では,水路の10の8つ近くが健康状態が悪いことが判明し,WWF慈善団体が"開かれた水道"として扱われていると,環境基準を満たしていないと判断した. この課題にもかかわらず,政府は2027年までに4分の3が健康状態になると予測していた. この結果についてコメントする際,グリーン党の共同指導者であるジョナサン・バートリーは,我々の川の状態は完全に受け入れられないと述べた.
2020-s-0418.impactJa: 環境庁は"現実的に達成できるものに基づいて"目標を今検討すると述べた.研究により,BBCニュースプラットフォームで環境慈善団体,活動家,学者が川汚染問題について強調した.それは,英国の川の健康を改善するための全ヨーロッパ努力の一環として設定した目標を達成するには遠いことを示した. 報道機関のメディア担当者,リス・スピイトは",このような捜査ジャーナリズムがなかったら,密集的なデータに埋まっている重要な物語は伝えられませんでした.この作品の裏のチームは細かい細かいことをし,実際に数字を調べ,この問題を理解し,事実を明確に伝える時間を費やしました".BBC のニュース担当者,リチャード・バーゲスは",調査と議論を必要になった話題について報道するのは,公益の重要な記事でした. データを分析し,視覚化し,数字を提示するデータジャーナリズムを通じて,我々のプログラムは,もしそうでなければ,目に見えないままに残っていたイングランド水路の課題について説得力のある物語を伝えることができました". 疑問は,人々が泳ぐ水について考えさせ,変化をもたらすために何ができるかを考えさせましたそれは汚染事故を報告するか,水の生態学的健康を改善するために働くグループや慈善団体に加わるかどうかです. 私たちのデータセットはテレビやラジオでジャーナリストと共有され, 貧しい川の区画を特定し,撮影,場所の2方向性などに使用できるようにしました.

2020-s-0419.summary: Undiagnosed diabetes is common in Kenya, and often usually leads to serious health complications. Untreated type 2 diabetes can go unnoticed for a long time considering that mild to moderate blood sugar levels often don’t have any symptoms.In the report released by the International Diabetes Federation (IDF) on World Diabetes Day on Nov 14, 38 million more adults are living with diabetes, compared to 2017 and global prevalence has reached 9.3 per cent, with more than half of adults undiagnosed.
2020-s-0419.impact: As one of the top causes of morbidity globally, highlighting on this condition that accounts for 8,000 deaths in Kenya as at 2019, causing concerns over increasing number of untreated patients and related medical costs is timely for the readers
2020-s-0419.authors: Nduta Waweru, Virginia Wambui and Sandra Wekesa
2020-s-0419.summaryJa: 診断されない糖尿病はケニアでよく流行ります. 治療を受けない2型糖尿病は,血糖の軽度から中程度のレベルが症状を呈しない場合も多いので,長い間見過ごされることがあります.世界糖尿病デーに11月14日に国際糖尿病連盟 (IDF) が発表した報告書では,2017年と比較して380万人以上の成人が糖尿病で生活しており,世界の流行率は9.3%に達し,半数以上が診断されていない.
2020-s-0419.impactJa: 2019年時点でケニアで8000人の死亡が原因となっているこの病因を強調し, 治療を受けていない患者の増加と関連医療費の懸念を醸し出すことは読者にとって及ばないことです

2020-s-0420.summary: Analysis of more than 350,000 words written over 15-years of Boris Johnson’s Telegraph columns helped us identify the topics and people he discusses the most. We also used a computing technique called “natural language processing” — a form of artificial intelligence that can interpret the meaning of sentences — to reveal the sentiment behind his words. This was a complicated analysis of a relatively light hearted subject, and so we set out to display the findings in a clear yet fun way. This led to an interactive extravaganza, topped off with a never ending Boris quiz.
2020-s-0420.impact: The overall reaction to the project was extremely positive. I received good feedback in the comments section, from others in the newsroom and on twitter where I shared the process behind the piece. The article was picked up by several outlets and featured in Politico’s London Playbook newsletter. I was also contacted by Factiva - a business information and research tool owned by Dow Jones - about how we could use their data to collaborate on other future projects. When we first discussed doing a project like this in the Spring of 2019, we planned to focus on the then prime minister Theresa May. However, the only source we had for was her parliament speeches, which were very scripted, formulated and similar. So when Boris Johnson became prime minister I had the idea to use his Telegraph articles as a basis for the analysis. This worked out perfectly - never before has a prime minister provided such a personal insight into their mind. The overall project benefited from having this volume of personal musings available and out there to analyse.
2020-s-0420.summaryJa: ボリス・ジョンソン氏のテレグラフコラムの15年以上にわたって書かれた35万語以上の言葉を分析することで,彼が最も議論する話題や人々を特定することができました.また,私たちは"自然言語処理"と呼ばれる計算技術を使用しました. 比較的軽いテーマの複雑な分析でした結果をはっきりとした楽しい方法で展示しようとしましたこれはインタラクティブな贅沢なテストに繋がりました
2020-s-0420.impactJa: プロジェクトに対する一般的な反応は非常に肯定的なものでした.コメント欄やニュースルームの他のメンバーから,そしてツイッターで,この作品の背後にあるプロセスを共有したところから,良いフィードバックを受けました.この記事はいくつかのメディアによって取り上げられ,Politico London Playbookのニュースレターに掲載されました.また,ダウ・ジョーンズの経営情報と研究ツールであるファクティバが連絡を取りました. 2019年春にこのようなプロジェクトを最初に議論したとき,当時の首相テレサ・メイに焦点を当てることを計画しました.しかし,我々が得た唯一の情報源は,彼女の議会演説でした.非常に脚本的で,公式で,そして類似したものです.ボリス・ジョンソン首相になったとき,私は彼のテレグラフ記事を分析の基盤として利用するアイデアを思いました.これは完璧にうまく機能しました.これまで首相は彼らの心の中にそのような個人的な洞察を提供したことがありませんでした. プロジェクト全体では,この量の人間の思考が利用可能で分析されるため,利益を得ました.

2020-s-0421.summary: Although there has been great reporting on the under-representation of ethnic minority characters in Hollywood movies, a data-driven look at how they are presented has been missing from the conversation. So, to illustrate how stereotypes have developed in Hollywood, we analyzed the tropes about different ethnic groups present in more than 6,000 Oscar-eligible movies since 1928. Our analysis and the accompanying reporting show that, even though some of the more obviously racist tropes have faded from cinema in the past decades, many stereotypical narratives have shifted rather than disappeared. This analysis was published in English, German, Turkish and Chinese.
2020-s-0421.impact: This article has enjoyed an exceptionally 'long tail' of visits: it still receives at least as many weekly visits as when it was first published. It also has an average dwell time of more than five minutes. Users generally spend more time with our data-driven stories than they do with other DW content, but this one stood out even among data-driven articles. The story was also discussed intensively on the DW News Facebook channel. The Turkish and Chinese language teams of DW also adapted the article, prompting discussion on social media in these communities as well.
2020-s-0421.summaryJa: ハリウッド映画における少数民族の登場人物があまり表現されていないという報道が多くあったが,その登場人物がどのように表現されているかについてのデータに基づく見方は,会話から欠けている. 分析と関連レポートは過去数十年で映画界から明らかに人種差別的な傾向が薄れていても消えるのではなくステレオタイプ的な物語が多く変わっていることを示していますこの分析は英語,ドイツ語,トルコ語,中国語で公開されました
2020-s-0421.impactJa: この記事は,特に"長い尾"の訪問を享受しています.まだ最初に発表されたときの少なくとも週間の訪問数を受け取っています.また平均滞在時間は5分以上です.ユーザーは一般的に他のDWコンテンツよりもデータベースのストーリーにより多くの時間を費やしますが,この記事はデータベースの記事の中でも顕著でした.この記事はDWニュースフェイスブックチャンネルでも活発に議論されました. DWのトルコ語と中国語チームは,この記事を改編し,これらのコミュニティでもソーシャルメディアで議論を促した.

2020-s-0422.summary: The Schengen area is supposed to be a border-free zone within Europe. But as large numbers of displaced people arrived in 2015, some Schengen countries reintroduced border controls. And they're still in place, since the countries have kept extending them for the past four years. Our data analysis shows how just how extraordinary that situation is, and interviews with MEPs and migration policy experts conclude that the continued extension of the controls may be illegal under EU law. This story was translated into Arabic, German, Romanian, Russian, Spanish and Urdu.
2020-s-0422.impact: This article was the most viewed article on DW.com for several days following its publication. It also got almost seven times our average views at DW Data, making it one of the most successful of our data-driven pieces to date. European news portal InfoMigrants picked up the story as well. It was also discussed widely on the social media channels of DW.
2020-s-0422.summaryJa: シェンゲン地域はヨーロッパ内での国境なき地域であるはずですが 2015年に大量に難民が到着したことでシェンゲン地域の一部は国境管制を再導入しましたこの国は4年間国境管制を継続して延長しているためまだ実施されていますデータの分析は,この状況がどれほど驚くべきものなのかを明らかにし,欧州議会議員と移民政策専門家とのインタビューで,継続的な規制拡大はEU法の下で違法である可能性があると結論づけています. この記事はアラビア語,ドイツ語,ルーマニア語,ロシア語,スペイン語,ウルドゥ語に翻訳されました.
2020-s-0422.impactJa: この記事は,DW.comで掲載後数日間で最も視聴された記事でした.また,DW Dataでは平均視聴率を7倍近く獲得し,これまでにデータ主導の作品の中で最も成功した作品の一つとなりました.欧州のニュースポータルInfoMigrantsもこの記事を取り上げました.また,DWのソーシャルメディアチャンネルでも広く議論されました.

2020-s-0423.summary: Africa's cities are booming. But they will be hit hard by climate change. In interviews with 30 urban Africans, from people scraping a living by picking through waste to UN climate scientists, DW looks at how four big and fast-growing cities are adapting to the problems each faces: Lagos to scorching heatwaves, Kampala to rising waste, Cairo to potentially looming drought and Dar es Salaam to choking traffic.
2020-s-0423.impact: One important metric for measuring the success of our articles is to look at the dwell time. In the two weeks after launch, visitors stayed on the page for an average of 24 minutes. The article also did well in terms of overall visits and page impressions. Another qualitative metric that is important to us is who shares the piece on social media. In line with other data-driven pieces, the megacities project was well-received among multipliers and stakeholders, such as the deputy executive director of the UN Environment Programme; the director of the International Institute for Environment and Development; Oxfam's Pan Africa director; ActionAid's acting secretary-general as well as multiple policy makers and researchers familiar with the topic.
2020-s-0423.authors: A. Niranjan, T. Walker, A. Kimmig, N. Isenson, J. Collins, M. Lesser, K. Schacht, T. Wills, S. Wüst, G. Cutanoski, K. Funck, K. Esterluß, L. Jandel, G. Grün, S. Hüls, B. Stöß, G. Fallisch, T. Giemza, O. Urusova-Maisels, S. Plank, O. Pock, V. Fischer
2020-s-0423.summaryJa: アフリカの都市は繁栄している. しかし,気候変動によって大きく影響を受ける.国連の気候科学者に採掘して生計を立てている人々から,30人の都市住民のインタビューで,DWは4つの大きな急速に成長する都市がどのように直面する問題に対応しているかを調べています. ラゴスから熱波への熱帯熱波,カンパラから荒廃の増加,カイロから潜在的に迫る干ばつ,ダルエスサラームから交通渋滞への窒息.
2020-s-0423.impactJa: 記事の成功を測定する重要な指標の一つは,滞在時間を見ることです.発売後2週間,訪問者は平均24分ページに留まりました.記事の総訪問とページインプレッションに関しては,うまく行いました.また,私たちにとって重要な質量指標は,作品をソーシャルメディアで共有する人です. 他のデータに基づく作品と同様に,メガシティプロジェクトは国連環境計画副執行長,国際環境開発研究所長官,オックスファム全アフリカ事務局長,アクションエイッドの代理事務総長,また,この問題を知っている複数の政策立案者や研究者のような倍率者と利益関係者間で良好な評価を受けました.

2020-s-0424.summary: “Game Change” explores the changing face of America’s most popular and violent sport – football – a decade into the game’s concussion crisis. Real Sports spent over a year filing public records requests to school districts around the country, seeking demographic data on boys playing the game. We found that over the last five years there has been a marked shift in exactly who is participating, with decreases among middle- and upper-class boys but increases — both as a percentage and a raw number — in participation by the poor.
2020-s-0424.impact: This was the first report of any kind – in journalism or academia – to show with actual data the shift in participation in American football. The story not only lays out the incontrovertible numbers that document this shift, but also considers the implications – not only for the game of football, but more importantly, for the disadvantaged young boys who are increasingly filling football rosters, and facing the risks that come with it. The segment further explores how the leaders of football in America, including the NCAA and the NFL, have responded to this trend by increasingly courting children and parents from the poorest and least educated communities in America. For example, the IRS form 990s of the NFL's 32 teams show millions of dollars of contributions to tackle football leagues in in some of the poorest and least-educated communities in the country. It's a finding that troubled public health experts, as studies show that parents in these communities have the least information and education about the risks of the game. The report had a significant impact on the public discourse. Journalists, policy makers, and the leaders of think tanks extensively referenced our research and reporting, noting the first-of-its-kind import. The Atlantic's Patrick Hruby wrote: "Last night Real Sports ran a must-watch segment on how high school football may be following the path of boxing: wealthy families and kids are abandoning the sport, while poorer families and kids are not. It fleshes out – with data! – what many people who cover and think about football and brain injuries have suspected for a while: richer families are pulling their kids, poorer family aren't. Highly recommend watching it." The Aspen Institute's Jon Solomon, the editorial director of the Sports and Society program, wrote: "Must watch… Terrific reporting through use of

2020-s-0425.summary: An international investigation with an international dimension that reveals, through international data and communications to the most important telecommunications companies in the world, how social media sites deliver their users ’data to the world's governments, how the world codified these practices, and what are internationalist moves against them.
2020-s-0425.impact: Primarily, the awareness of more than 3.196 billion people with an account - at least - on a social networking site, which prompted daily new discoveries about the leak of user data. In addition to the major communications companies apologies to its users. And their officials stand against international courts before the world.
2020-s-0425.authors: Investigative: Maha Salaheldin draw: Sahar Issa Graphic: Ahmed Yassin Video: Ahmed Abdel-Ghani Infographic: Michael Adel Video: Nassim Abdel-Fattah Editing: Ahmed Abdel Shafie Programming: Mohamed Ezzat General supervision: Alaa Al-Ghatrifi
2020-s-0425.summaryJa: 国際的な次元を持つ国際調査で,世界最大の通信会社への国際データと通信を通じて,ソーシャルメディアサイトがどのようにユーザーデータを世界政府へ届け,世界がこの慣行をどのように編入し,国際主義的な動きがどのようなものなのかを明らかにしています.
2020-s-0425.impactJa: ソーシャルメディアのサイトでアカウントを持つ30億6000万人以上の人の意識が主にユーザーデータの漏洩について日々新しい発見を促した.また,主要な通信会社もユーザーに謝罪し,その官僚は国際裁判所に訴える.

2020-s-0426.summary: A visual essay of the Indian
2020-s-0426.impact: The project has been featured in several pages and social networks, however the most important impact was to empower the readers to understand how the different news outlets in India were representing the elections. We were aware of the fact the thousands of trolls and bots were giving partisan (or false) views of India during the campaign, we hoped that giving a not-biased, and easy to access story of elections updated every day would have helped the people. We believe that, even if on a small scale, we have been able to reach the people and help them understand what was happening in their country during the campaign.
2020-s-0426.summaryJa: インド人の視覚的エッセイ
2020-s-0426.impactJa: このプロジェクトは数ページやソーシャルネットワークで紹介されていますが,最も重要な影響は,インドのさまざまなニュース機関が選挙をどのように表現しているのか理解できるように読者に力を与えることでした.私たちは,選挙中に何千ものトロルやボットがインドについて党派的な (または偽) 見解を提示していたことを知っていました. 選挙運動の期間中に国民に何が起きているのか理解させるのに手を伸ばせることができました

2020-s-0427.summary: In the paper edition of the newspaper we made this infographic to pay tribute to tennis player Rafa Nadal for once again achieving number 1 on the ATP list. We make a pie chart dividing it by years, in each year you can see the achievements and their classification.
2020-s-0427.impact: It had a lot of repercussion when gathering the information in a (circular) way of a career as long as that of Rafa Nadal in an unconventional way. In social networks he had a lot of repercussion and tennis specialists named him on his channels.
2020-s-0427.summaryJa: 紙版の新聞ではテニス選手ラファ・ナダルを敬うためにこのインフォグラフィックを作りました ATPリストで再び1位を獲得したため. 私たちはパイチャートを作りました.
2020-s-0427.impactJa: ラーファ・ナダルのキャリアの (円形) 方法で情報を収集する際に非常に大きな影響を与えた. ソーシャルメディアでは彼は多くの影響を受け,テニス専門家が彼のチャンネルで彼を名付けました.

2020-s-0428.summary: I have delivered over five Telegraph front pages on rising crimes and declining charge rates in the UK through the use of open data and freedom of information. The UK's Home Office publishes quarterly and annual data on the number of crimes and the police outcomes of each of them - broken down by police force area and crime type. This is a wealth of data which I've used to write multiple public interest stories on the increasing crime problems in the country. They are topics that interest our readers, and so we use data journalism to surface these stories.
2020-s-0428.impact: My data-led stories and interactives on crime have highlighted how Government decisions have directly impacted the likelihood of catching criminals. This is something that Telegraph readers, and wider society, care a lot about. We created two interactives this year on the topic - one of which is a tool in which our subscribers can type in their postcode and find out how the story impacts themselves. The reader can find out how many crimes take place in their area, how many end up in the criminal being charged and how this rate compares to the national average. This is what we try and do at The Telegraph’s Data Journalism team. We aim to surface exclusive news stories that our readers will devour on the front-page, but also combine that with interactives that have genuine utility and connection to our readers’ lives. The impact of this is clear: we can surface important public interest stories, and show personalised data to our reader. This gives them the tools to hold their local authorities to account.
2020-s-0428.authors: Ashley Kirk, Charles Hymas, Ellie Kempster
2020-s-0428.summaryJa: 私は,オープンデータと情報の自由の利用を通じて,英国における犯罪の増加と課税率低下に関するテレグラフの前面ページを5ページ以上配信しました.英国内務省は,警察部隊の領域と犯罪型によって分別された犯罪の数と警察の結果に関する四半期および年次データを公表しています.これは私が国内における犯罪問題の増加に関する複数の公共の関心に関する記事を書くために使用したデータの大量です. メディアはデータジャーナリズムを使って物語を公開しています
2020-s-0428.impactJa: 犯罪に関する私のデータ主導の記事やインタラクティブは,政府の決定が犯罪者を捕まえる可能性に直接どのように影響を与えているかを強調しています.これはテレグラフ読者や社会全体にとって非常に重要なことです.今年,このテーマに関する2つのインタラクティブを作成しました.そのうちの1つは,私たちのサブスクリプションが郵便番号を入力し,その物語が自分自身にどのように影響を与えるかを調べることができるツールです. 読み手は,自分の地域で何件もの犯罪が起きているのか,何件が犯罪者として起訴されるのか,この割合が全国平均とどのように比較されるのかを知ることができます.これは,テレグラフのデータジャーナリズムチームでやってみようとしています.私たちは読者が前ページに食べられる独占的なニュース記事を表すことを目指しています.しかし,それを読者の生活に真の有用性とつながりを持つインタラクティブと組み合わせます. この影響は明らかです:私たちは重要な公共の関心事に関する物語を浮上させ,個人化されたデータを読者に示し,地元の自治体を説明するためにツールを与えることができます.

2020-s-0429.summary: In The Lost Billions, JPIMedia Investigations uncovered the alarming rise in cost of the UK’s Private Finance Initiative – a controversial method of funding public sector infrastructure projects through long-term deals with the private sector. We revealed it is now set to cost the UK taxpayer £5 billion more than expected, while some buildings costing millions each year are simply lying empty. This collaborative investigation ran across some 100 JPIMedia titles, including the national newspaper i , as well as major regional and local newspapers including The Scotsman and The Yorkshire Post.
2020-s-0429.impact:
The Private Finance Initiative sees private companies build and run hospitals, schools, roads or other projects for a set term (usually 25 years but sometimes longer), with public sector bodies paying an annual fee. At the end of the deal, ownership of the building usually passes to the public authority. While PFI has now been scrapped for new infrastructure schemes, some 700 existing contracts remain in place, with the last repayments set to end in 2050. Our investigation revealed:
    The total lifetime cost of these 700 PFI contracts is now set to be £5bn higher than had been expected when the agreements were first signed, with the taxpayer picking up the bill; Some PFI-financed buildings have been mothballed while expensive payments continue; Private firms are charging the public sector a high price to make changes to PFI buildings, such as a school billed more than £25,000 for three parasols.
The investigation made the front page of the i newspaper, with its extensive coverage running across three days. Regional and local versions of the investigation, highlighting rip-off contracts in different parts of the UK, ran in more than 100 local and regional titles across the JPIMedia stable – many making their front pages. The Lost Billions put the spending of hundreds of health bodies, police forces, councils and Government departments under the spotlight, asking difficult questions of today’s decision-makers as well as those who originally signed up to the contracts. The investigation prompted a public discussion of how the UK can rid itself of the expensive legacy of old PFI contracts, with Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell ending up in a Twitter spat with the Conservatives over who was to blame for the situation and how best to rectify it.
2020-s-0429.authors: John Blow, Philip Bradfield, Isabella Cipirska, Tom Cotterill, Michael Holmes, Anna Khoo, Dean Kirby, Joel Lamy, Paul Lynch, Chris McCall, Claire Wilde
2020-s-0429.summaryJa: 失われた数十億ドルでJPIMedia調査は,英国民間金融イニシアチブ (PFI) のコストの懸念を明らかにしました.これは民間部門との長期契約を通じて公共部門のインフラプロジェクトを資金提供する論争の的的な方法です.現在,英国納税者は予想以上に50億ドルを支払う予定ですが,毎年何百万もの費用がかかる建物も単に空いている. この共同調査は,全国新聞 i,および主要地域および地方新聞 The Scotsman,The Yorkshire Postを含む約100件のJPIMediaタイトルを対象とした.
2020-s-0429.impactJa: 民間資金イニシアチブでは,民間企業が病院,学校,道路,その他のプロジェクトを一定の期間 (通常25年,時にはそれ以上) に建設し運営し,公営部門機関が年金を払うことが見られる.取引終了後,建物所有権は通常公営機関に移行する.PFIは新しいインフラ計画のために廃止されているが,約700の既存の契約は依然として存在し,最後の返済は2050年に終了する. 調査の結果,この700の PFI契約の生涯費用は,税金支払者が請求を集めて,契約が最初に署名されたときの予想より50億ドル以上になると見込まれています. 高価な支払いが継続している間に, PFIが資金を提供した建物の一部が廃墟になった. 調査は3日間の広範な報道で,i新聞の正面に載った.調査の地域および地域版は,英国のさまざまな地域で詐欺契約を強調し,JPIMediaの100以上の地域および地域タイトルで安定した. 失われた数十億は何百もの保健機関,警察,議会,政府部門の支出を注目し, 決定者や当初契約を締結した人々に対して難しい質問を投げかけました捜査は,英国が古いPFI契約の高価な遺産をどのように取り除くことが出来るのかについての公的な議論を促し,シャドウ・キャンセラージョン・マクドネルは,状況に誰が責任があるか,そしてそれをどのように改善するかについて保守党とツイッターで議論を巻き起こしました.

2020-s-0430.summary: Alex Homer from the BBC’s Shared Data Unit carried out the most in-depth analysis to date of the controversial Right to Buy policy, which allows council tenants to purchase their council homes at a discount. He used a variety of investigative and data journalism techniques to establish whether there was any evidence that the purpose of the policy was being undermined by former tenants treating it as a get-rich-quick scheme. The story involved sourcing multiple datasets and using data analysis to paint a comprehensive UK-wide picture of a policy that has come under fierce scrutiny.
2020-s-0430.impact: This report and research sparked widespread discussion. It was carried by three national newspapers, it had 1.6m readers on the BBC website and it was broadcast on television by the BBC News Channel. It was debated on TV, radio and across social media. A further 65 regional media outlets used Alex's research in reports of their own, as did nine BBC local radio stations and a further local BBC TV news programme. It was published against a background of Scotland and Wales having brought the policy to an end, and while Northern Ireland consulted on the future of its equivalent scheme. An extension of the policy to include housing association tenants was however being trailed in England. Supporters said this policy had given millions of people the chance to get on the housing ladder and secure their families' financial future. Opponents blamed the policy for distorting the housing market and for a huge reduction in the amount of social housing stock. Our analysis - the first on this UK-wide scale, covering 18 years' of data - revealed around 92,000 former council homes which were later resold, made a collective £6.4bn profit in real terms. Alex's findings led Labour's London Assembly housing spokesman to renew his call for the policy to end https://twitter.com/tomcopley/status/1106173993881649152 and the Mayor of Newham to say the same https://www.newhamrecorder.co.uk/news/newham-council-right-to-buy-resales-1-5956677. Many more of Alex's interviewees called for the existing scheme to be halted. His Interviews held the politicians of the day to account over the trial extension of the policy and the author put further questions about its impact to one architect of the scheme nearly 40 years ago, Lord Heseltine, although he declined to answer. This report was featured in the top 10 round-up of data journalism projects by the Global Investigative Journalism Network: https://gijn.org/2019/03/21/gijns-data-journalism-top-10-frances-shocking-yellow-vest-injuries-yield-curve-music-migration-maps/.
2020-s-0430.summaryJa: BBCの共有データユニットのアレックス・ホーマー氏は,議会賃貸者が,議会住宅を割引で購入することを可能にする論争の的になった買取権利政策のこれまでの最も深い分析を行った.彼は,政策の目的が,富を急に増やす計画として扱った元賃貸者が損なっているという証拠があるかどうかを確認するために,さまざまな調査技術とデータジャーナリズムを使用した. 詳細は,多くのデータセットを調達し,データ分析を使用して,厳しい調査を受けた政策の包括的な英国全体的なイメージを描いた.
2020-s-0430.impactJa: このレポートと研究は広範な議論を招いた.このレポートは3つの全国新聞で報道され,BBCウェブサイトで1600万人の読者がいたし,BBCニュースチャンネルによってテレビで放送された.テレビ,ラジオ,ソーシャルメディアで議論された.さらに65の地域メディアは,BBCの9つの地元のラジオ局とBBCの地元のテレビニュース番組と同様に,アレックスの研究を独自のレポートで利用した. イングランドでは,住宅協会の賃貸者を含む政策の延長が続いていた.支持者は,この政策は,何百万人もの人々に住宅の階段を上り,家族の財政的未来を保障する機会を与えると述べた. 反対派は政策を住宅市場を歪めるものとして社会的住宅の量が大幅に削減されるものとして非難した.この調査は,英国規模で初めて,18年間のデータを対象に,18年間を対象としたもので,後に再売却された92,000の元議会住宅が,実質的に総額64億ポンドの利益を得ていることが明らかになった. アレックス氏の発見により,労働組合のロンドン議会の住宅スポークスマンが,政策を終了するよう呼びかけを更新し,ニューハムの市長も同じことを言われました. アレックス・アレクスのインタビューの多くは,既存の計画を停止するよう求めた.彼のインタビューでは,その時の政治家たちが政策の試用延長について説明を求めた.著者は40年前,計画の建築家であるヘセルトイン卿に,その影響についてさらなる疑問を投げかけましたが,彼は答えることを拒否した. このレポートはグローバル調査ジャーナリズムネットワークによるデータジャーナリズムプロジェクトのトップ10のまとめに掲載されました: https://gijn.org/2019/03/21/gijns-data-journalism-top-10-frances-shocking-yellow-vest-injury-yield-curve-music-migration-maps/.

2020-s-0431.summary: During one month and a half, El Confidencial Data Team has scraped every 30 minutes the real-time Madrid subway incidents web to find how many times escalators and elevators have not been working. The data collection was captured in a database with 1,549 records for each station. With this data, we produced two articles: the first one, published on July 29th, shows the stations with more unavailable escalators and elevators; the second one, published on September 6th, is focused on the difficulties for parents to move children's carriages on the subway.
2020-s-0431.impact: It was the first time that anyone could measure how many times escalators and elevators of Madrid subway were broken. After that, we made a second report about newly born families that have a lot of problems to access to non-accesible stations. The two reports has a huge impact in terms of pageviews, with more than 60,000 visits. Further, Madrid subway company reacted with some internal criticism towards our reports.
2020-s-0431.authors: Cristina Suárez, Michael McLoughlin, Jesús Escudero, Antonio Hernández, Pablo López Learte, Laura Marín, Pablo Narváez, Luis Rodríguez, Carmen Castellón
2020-s-0431.summaryJa: エル・コンフィデッショナル・データ・チームは1ヶ月半の間,リアルタイムマドリード地下鉄事故のウェブを30分ごとにスクラップし,エスカレーターやエレベーターが何度働かなくなったかを調べました. 7月29日に発表された最初の記事はエスカレーターやエレベーターが増えるのを示すもので 9月6日に発表された2つの記事は両親が地下鉄で子供たちの車を移動する困難に焦点を当てています
2020-s-0431.impactJa: マドリード地下鉄のエスカレーターやエレベーターが壊れたことを初めて測定した.その後,私たちは,アクセスできない駅へのアクセスに多くの問題を抱える新生児の家族について2つ目のレポートを作成しました.この2つのレポートは,ページビューに関して大きな影響をもたらし,6万件以上の訪問を記録しました.さらに,マドリード地下鉄会社は,我々のレポートに対する内部的な批判で反応しました.

2020-s-0432.summary: The urban fabrics of cities tell a lot of stories. From roman roots to monarchs and dictators who shaped cities according to their will to the consequences of WW2 bombings to all the different approaches to building and structuring a city that emerged since the 19<sup>th</sup>century. Being a trained urban planner, I know a lot of those stories by heart and have explained them, pointing at a city plan to friends and family many times. For this story, my colleague Anna-Lena Kornfeld and I took all those experiences and condensed them into a map/visualization-heavy storytelling for a broader public.
2020-s-0432.impact: We've luckily received a lot of positive feedback from our readers. Ranging from ordinary readers to experts (geographers, historians and urban designers). One expert is now using our story as teaching material in his university urban planning history course.
2020-s-0432.summaryJa: 都市の都市構造は多くの物語を語っています. ローマの根源から,君主や独裁者が自分たちの意志に従って都市を形作るまで, 第二次世界大戦の爆撃の結果まで, 19世紀以降に生まれた都市建設と構造化に関する様々なアプローチまで. 訓練された都市計画者として,私はそれらの物語を多くを覚え,友人や家族に都市計画を何度も指摘して説明してきました. この物語のために私は同僚のアナ・レーナ・コーーンフェルドとこれらの経験を全て取り出しより広い大衆のために地図や視覚化に重なる物語に収縮しました
2020-s-0432.impactJa: 幸運にも,読者から多くのポジティブなフィードバックが来ました. 普通読者から専門家まで (地理学者,歴史家,都市設計者) です. ある専門家が今,私たちの物語を大学都市計画史講座の教材として利用しています.

2020-s-0433.summary: Thanks to the Spanish Transparency Law, we would be able to obtain 29 agreements between city councils and football team from the First and Second Division of LaLiga for the rental of the local stadiums where the football teams play. It was the first time that this information was compilated and published in Spain and shows the agreements between the councils and the teams for the use of each stadium.
2020-s-0433.impact: It was the first time that the agreements between city councils and football professional teams for renting public stadiums was published in Spain. All the agreements and documents are published in El Confidencial's Github repository (https://github.com/ECLaboratorio/unidad-de-datos/tree/master/proyectos/convenios_estadios). In terms of pageviews, the article had more than 60,000 views, much above the average and median for a report published on El Confidencial.
2020-s-0433.authors: Diego Cayota, Darío Ojeda, Antonio Hernández
2020-s-0433.summaryJa: スペインの透明性法のおかげで,我々は,地方のスタジアムをレンタルするために,ラリガの第1および第2リーグから市議会とサッカーチームとの間で29の契約を得ることができました.この情報はスペインで初めて収集され,公表され,各スタジアムの使用のための協議会とチームとの協定を示しています.
2020-s-0433.impactJa: スペインでは初めて市議会とサッカープロのチームとの公共スタジアムレンタに関する協定が公表された.すべての協定と文書はEl ConfidencialのGithubリポジトリに公開されている. ページビューの観点から,この記事は6万件以上で,El Confidencialで掲載されたレポートの平均と平均値よりもはるかに高い.

2020-s-0434.summary: Mexico is extremely corrupt, politicians steal money without sanctions. The modus operandi all across Latin America is very similar: government officials create ghost companies, the government assigns projects to these fake businesses and the money disappears. How could we detect these companies? That’s how we started this project. Sinapsis is a tool that visualizes relationships between businesses and government entities, as well as how companies and their personnel are interconnected. As a free, open-source project, it’s designed to help detect irregularities and suspicious activity in business interactions and practices.
2020-s-0434.impact: Animal Político has already published two very important investigations done with Sinapsis on corruption in Mexico: The Ghost Companies of Veracruz and The Master Scam. The latter revealed that the Mexican Federal Government disappeared 7,670 million pesos (around 400 million dollars) through 186 companies. These investigations won the National Journalism Award. Even more important, they have been the basis for the prosecution of several former and current public officials in Mexico. It is a tool that has been proved and used. Only a couple months into its publication, there are already 180 different projects using it and at least 5 people forking the code on GitHub to adapt it to their needs. The tool also includes the investigation methodology; tips on useful public databases; promotes the use of open data pre charging relevant databases on the tool to facilitate analysis; builds community through a Telegram channel open to doubts and suggestions; and is working on the process of systematizing information on corrupt companies across Latin America. To date, we have allies collaborating from Argentina, Bolivia, Brasil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guatemala, Honduras, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Dominican Republic and Venezuela. During this first phase, we want to train local journalists in Mexico. So far, we have given workshops in Mexico City, Hidalgo, Guadalajara, and have already scheduled Puebla, Tijuana and Mexicali. We would like, further down the line, with the right allies and resources to be able to reach different countries in Latin America. The project has had international recognition, the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime has invited us to their regional convention in Quito, Ecuador and are presenting in TicTec in march in Iceland.
2020-s-0434.authors: Yosune Chamizo Alberro, Gilberto León, Mauricio Martínez Robles, Jesús Santamaría, Elizabeth Cruz, Ethan Murillo, Jorge Ramis, Nayeli Roldán, Manuel Ureste, Miriam Castillo, Arturo Ángel, Tania L. Montalvo, Francisco Sandoval, Daniel Moreno
2020-s-0434.summaryJa: メキシコは極度に腐敗しており,制裁なしに政治家が金を盗んでいる. ラテンアメリカ全土での行動方法は非常に類似しています. 政府関係者は幽霊企業を作り,政府は偽造企業にプロジェクトを割り当て,お金は消える.どうやってこれらの企業を検出できるのでしょうか? シナプシスは,企業と政府機関との関係を視覚化するツールであり,企業とそのスタッフがどのように相互接続されているかを視覚化するツールです.無料でオープンソースのプロジェクトとして,ビジネス相互作用と実践における不規則性や疑わしい活動を検出するのに役立ちます.
2020-s-0434.impactJa: アニマル・ポリティコは,メキシコにおける腐敗に関するシナプスと行われた2つの非常に重要な調査を既に公表している.その2つはベラクラウスのゴースト・カンパニーとマスター・スキャム.この2つはメキシコ連邦政府が186社の企業を通じて7,670億ペソ (約4億ドル) を失踪したことを明らかにした.これらの調査はナショナルジャーナリズム賞を受賞した. さらに重要なのは,メキシコの元および現在の公務員数人の起訴の根拠となってきたこと. これは証明され,使用されたツールです. 出版後わずか数ヶ月で,すでに180の異なるプロジェクトが利用しており,少なくとも5人が GitHubでコードを自分のニーズに合わせて調整している. また,このツールには調査方法論,有用な公共データベースに関するヒント,分析を容易にするために,ツールに関する関連データベースを充電する前にオープンデータの利用を促進し,疑惑や提案に開放されたテレグラムチャンネルを通じてコミュニティを構築し,ラテンアメリカ全域で腐敗した企業に関する情報を体系化するプロセスに取り組んでいます. 現在,アルゼンチン,ボリビア,ブラジル,チリ,コロンビア,コスタリカ,エクアドル,グアテマラ,ホンジュラス,パナマ,パラグアイ,ペルー,ドミニカ共和国,ベネズエラから協力する同盟国があります.この最初の段階では,メキシコで地元のジャーナリストを訓練したいと考えています.これまでにメキシコシティ,ヒダルゴ,グアダラハラでワークショップを開催し,すでにプエブラ,ティフアナ,メキシコリカに予定しています. 更に,我々は,適切な同盟国や資源を,ラテンアメリカの様々な国々に届けたいと思っています. このプロジェクトは国際的に認められ,国連麻薬犯罪事務局は,エクアドル州キトで開催される地域会議に招き,アイスランドで開催されるTicTecで発表しています.

2020-s-0435.summary: As part of our "Generation Under Fire: Guns, Right & Safety" special, News 6, WKMG-TV embarked on a research project to study the history of fatal shootings on America’s school campuses. After an exhaustive search, we discovered no comprehensive and visual representation of this issue. All but four states in the country have had a fatal school shooting since 1960. In analyzing thousands of incidents during that 59-year period, the News 6 Investigators identified more than 600 fatal school shootings that killed over 900 people and wounded another 700+.
2020-s-0435.impact: For our audience, this story was important as it coincided with the one-year remembrance of the shootings at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, FL, a shooting that killed 17 teachers and students. WKMG did not take a stand for or against or delve into the debate over Second Amendment rights. We instead focused on the number of fatal shootings and the specific instances of concern derived from the data. None of us expected to find out almost a thousand people have died in school shootings in the U.S. since 1960, but it wasn’t a surprise to discover that most of the deaths occurred in high schools. In fact in the 1960s, there were seven fatal shootings in high schools; in the 1990s, that number peaked at 111. University fatal shootings are on the rise as well coming dangerously close to the number of fatal shootings in high schools in the 2010s. States with the most fatal school shootings held surprises as well. The top three states: California, Texas, and Florida. New York state was number 12 on the list and was tied with Oregon, South Carolina, and Washington D.C In a significant representation of this project’s impact after the story was published, the Department of Homeland Security recognized our project on one of their social media accounts and thanked us for the inclusion of their own studies. For 2020, WKMG along with five other sister-stations in the Graham Media Group, is exploring the idea of adding 2019 statistics to this study and mapping each individual school shooting location. One other possibility is to create 47 other infographics to delve deeper into statistics and individual stories for each state and the District of Columbia that has had a fatal school shooting across what would then be a 60-year period.
2020-s-0435.summaryJa: ニュース6号"Generation Under Fire: Guns, Right & Safety"の特別番組として,WKMG-TVはアメリカの学校校内での致命的な銃撃事件の歴史を研究する研究プロジェクトを始めました. 徹底的な調査の後,この問題の包括的な視覚的表現は見つかりませんでした. 1960 年以降,全国の4 州を除き,全州で銃撃事件が起きています.その 59 年期間の何千もの事件を分析したニュース 6 捜査官は,900 人以上の死因を引き起こし,700 人以上の負傷を引き起こした 600 件以上の銃撃事件を特定しました.
2020-s-0435.impactJa: 聴衆にとって,この話は重要なことでした.それは,フロリダ州パークランドにあるマージョリー・ストーンマン・ダグラス高校での銃撃事件の1年記念日と一致したため,銃撃事件で17人の教師と生徒が死亡した.WKMGは第二修正案の権利に関する議論に賛成または反対を唱え,進んでみませんでした.代わりに,銃撃事件の数とデータから得られた特定の懸念事例に焦点を当てました. 1960年以降,米国では学校での銃撃でほぼ1000人が死亡したと予想した人はいませんが,ほとんどの死は高校で起きたことを発見することは驚きではありません.実際,1960年代に高校で7件の致命的な銃撃事件が発生し,1990年代にその数は111人に達しました.大学での致命的な銃撃事件は増加しており,2010年代に高校での致命的な銃撃事件数に危険に接近しています. 州では学校での銃撃事件が最も致命的な事件でした.トップ3州はカリフォルニア,テキサス,フロリダ.ニューヨーク州はリストの第12位で,オレゴン,サウスカロライナ,ワシントンDCと並列された.このプロジェクトの影響が物語が発表された後,国土安全保障省は,私たちのプロジェクトをソーシャルメディアアカウントの一つで認識し,自身の研究を含むことに感謝しました. 2020年,WKMGはグラハムメディアグループ内の5つの姉妹ステーションとともに,この研究に2019年の統計を追加し,各学校での撮影地点をマッピングするというアイデアを探索しています.別の可能性は,60年間の間にわたって致命的な学校での銃撃事件を経験した各州およびコロンビア地区の統計と個々の物語を深く調べるために他の47のインフォグラフィックを作成することです.

2020-s-0436.summary: The Hungarian housing market recently went through a price boom mostly affecting larger cities and the capital, partly as a result of the stabilisation following the economic world crisis and low interests. Budapest prices increased extraordinarily even in worldwide comparison, as over the past decade, prices quadrupled in numerous streets. We mapped this process, highlighting neighbourhoods and construction methods that were considered cheaper and less popular earlier, but were greatly affected by the changes. We attempted to show how housing became a severe problem for some in Budapest where others might have seen a profitable investment opportunity.
2020-s-0436.impact: The article achieved its goal, our readers received an easy-to-grasp overview of the processes on the housing market that made home purchases significantly more difficult for some while creating a lucrative investment opportunity for others. A fifth of Index's daily visitors have read the original Hungarian article, a tenth of whom went on to share it on social media.
2020-s-0436.summaryJa: ハンガリー住宅市場は最近価格ブームを経験しました大都市と首都に影響を与えました部分的には世界経済危機と低利の後,安定化の結果です変化によって大きく影響を受けていた住宅がバダペストの何人かのために深刻な問題になったことを示そうとしたのです他の人々は利益の機会を見ていたかもしれません
2020-s-0436.impactJa: 記事の目標を達成したとき,私たちの読者は住宅市場のプロセスについて簡単に把握した概要を得ましたそれは,住宅購入を一部の者にとって,かなり難しくなった一方で,他者にとって利益をもたらす投資機会を作り出した.

2020-s-0437.summary: We revealed that a national shortage of GPs has left some surgeries with one permanent doctor caring for as many as 11,000 patients. The local scandals were uncovered using detailed analysis of every general practice workforce report released by NHS England between 2013 and 2019. From here we began our reporting, visiting the worst-hit (as well the best performing) surgeries to verify what the data had revealed and humanaise our findings. Looking into the demographics, we were also able to reveal that 1.3 million women in England do not have regular access to a female GP.
2020-s-0437.impact: Our investigation into the scale of the crisis in general practice services had a strong impact on our readership, as well as in the public debate. It was picked up by other national media such as BBC, Daily Mail, Sun, Telegraph, Metro. The project was published soon after the December general election, contributing to setting the new political agenda. By highlighting the most extreme cases where patients were suffering the most, this story renewed pressure on the Prime Minister to fulfill his electoral pledge to recruit 6,000 GPs by 2024-25. After the story was published, the Health Secretary Matt Hancock spoke out to reassure the public that the Tory pledge to tackle the NHS staffing crisis was underway. The story received over 1,500 comments from online readers, showing a strong interest in the topic and high engagement. Since the findings were published, The Times has been contacted by hundreds of people sharing their personal experiences with their GP practices. Their stories have been gathered for a piece of community journalism, published a month later. The lookup interactive tool we created to allow readers to check how services have changed in their area, has been viewed over 23,000 times, with more than 3,000 searches.
2020-s-0437.authors: Anna Lombardi, Paul Morgan-Bentley, Daniel Clark
2020-s-0437.summaryJa: 国内でGPの不足が起きて,1人の常任医者が11,000人の患者さんを治療している手術がいくつか起こりました. 2013年から2019年の間に NHSイングランドが発表したすべての一般実践労働力報告書の詳細な分析を使用して地元のスキャンダルは明らかになりました. ここから私たちは報告を開始し,データから明らかになったことを確認し,私たちの発見を人間化するために最も悪影響を受けた (および最も優れたパフォーマンスを発揮する) 手術を訪問しました. 統計を見るとイギリスの1300万人の女性が定期的に女性の医師に診療を受けていないことが明らかになりました
2020-s-0437.impactJa: 一般実務サービスにおける危機の規模に関する我々の調査は,読者層だけでなく,公論においても大きな影響を与えた. メディアは,BBC,A-single-GP-looks-11-000-patients-one-practice-NHS-figures-reveal.html,Daily Mail,A-href="https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/10599480/national-shortage-of-gp-patients-crisis/Suna>,A-href="www.teph.uk.co.news/12/22/insita-best-paid-gref-study-s-western-find-telebrands-news/www.teph.co.world/2019/22/insita-best-paid-gref-s-western-find-telebrands-best-s-western-study-s-study-s-t-western-news/news/news/10599480/national-shortage-of-gp-patients-crisis/Suna>,A-single-GP-looks-11-000-patients-one-one-practice-one-one- graph, Metro.このプロジェクトは12月総選挙後すぐに発表された.新しい政治・議題を設定するのに貢献した.最も極端な症例を強調することで,この記事は2024年までに6000人のGPを募集するという選挙約束を果たすよう首相に圧力を加えた. ニュース発表後,健康大臣マット・ハンコックは,ToryがNHSのスタッフ危機に対処する約束を公に伝えました.この記事はオンライン読者から1500以上のコメントを受け付け,話題に強い関心と高い関与を示した.発見が公表されて以来,タイムズは数百人の医師の実践で個人的な経験を共有した人々から連絡を受けた. 彼らの物語はコミュニティジャーナリズムの一覧として集めており,1ヶ月後に公開された.私たちは読者が自分の地域でサービスがどのように変化したか確認できるようにしたインタラクティブな検索ツールが,3,000回以上で閲覧されています.

2020-s-0438.summary: Outdoor particulate pollution known as PM2.5 is responsible for millions of deaths around the world each year and many more illnesses. We created a special project that visualizes this damaging but often invisible pollution. The interactive article allows readers to (safely) experience what it’s like to breathe some of the worst air in the world in comparison to the air in their own city or town, giving them a more personal understanding of the scale of this public health hazard.
2020-s-0438.impact: This air pollution visualization project was one of The Times' most-viewed stories of the year, garnering well over a million page views in a single day. It also had some of the highest reader engagement. Readers took to social media, unprompted, to share the air pollution averages for their own city as well as screenshots of the project’s visualizations, and to express concern over recent upticks in air pollution. Making air pollution more tangible to the general public is especially important today, as air quality in the United States has worsened after decades of gains, while much of the world’s population continues to breathe high levels of pollution. At the same time, it is becoming more clear that air pollution affects human health at ever more granular scales. Experts from the public health community, including the United Nations and WHO, have reached out about using the project for educational purposes.
2020-s-0438.authors: Nadja Popovich, Blacki Migliozzi, Karthik Patanjali, Anjali Singhvi and Jon Huang
2020-s-0438.summaryJa: 汚染物質は PM2.5として知られるもので毎年世界中で何百万もの死因と多くの病気の原因です私たちはこの有害な視覚化するプロジェクトを作成しましたインタラクティブな記事では,読者が自分の都市や町で空気を呼吸する中で,世界で最も悪い空気を呼吸する (安全) 体験をすることができます.
2020-s-0438.impactJa: この空気汚染視覚化プロジェクトは,タイムの"年の最も視聴された記事の一つであり,たった1日で100万ページ以上閲覧を記録した.また,読者の関与も最高だった.読者は,自社市の空気汚染平均値とプロジェクトの画面をシェアし,最近の空気汚染の上昇に懸念を表明するために,気軽にソーシャルメディアを利用した. 汚染を一般市民により知覚できることが特に重要なことは,米国の空気質が何十年も改善していた後に悪化しているので,世界の住民の多くが汚染の高いレベルを呼吸しているのである.同時に,汚染がより細かい規模で人の健康に影響を及ぼしていることが明らかになります. 国連やWHOを含む公衆衛生の専門家が教育目的でこのプロジェクトを使用することを提案しています

2020-s-0439.summary: This project is a feature story about Myanmar Economy that was compared by ASEAN countries. Myanmar is one of the lowest developing countries among the regional. This story has focused on the weak points of Myanmar macroeconomy like export, deficit, tax revenue, expenditure, foreign reserve, growth rate, inflation and some others. Almost in all of the indicators, Myanmar is the lowest. Therefore, I wrote the story which lets the decision makers in Myanmar know about the country's current economic situation among the regional. And then what is our weakness and how to prepare for it.
2020-s-0439.impact: This story has been published in print and online version in both English and Myanmar language. It has been shared 9.1 k on the web for English version and 3.6 k for Myanmar version. The Myanmar Times newspaper is one of the best media in Myanmar and it has been distributed all through the country and also has a lot of audiences including government policy makers, members of parliament, civil society, NGO, INGO and think tank organizations. Currently, the Myanmar Times has 1.7 million readers on the web and 4.6 million on Facebook page. This is the most-viewed stories in the Myanmar Times in 2019. And policy makers, members of Parliament, civil society and other organizations are aware of what the economic situation is. I just thought this is the work of a business journalist. On the other hand, I have been looking forward to how to prepare for economic development and how to decide their policy and how to do the implementation process.
2020-s-0439.authors: Thit Nay Moe & Aung Kyaw Tun, The Myanmar Times, Phandeeyar
2020-s-0439.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,アジア連合 (ASEAN) の国々によって比較されたミャンマー経済に関する長編物語です.ミャンマーは地域の中で最も低い発展途上国の一つです.この記事は,輸出,赤字,税收,支出,外汇準備金,成長率,インフレなどのミャンマーマーのマクロ経済の弱点に焦点を当てています.ほぼすべての指標では,ミャンマーが最も低い. そこで私は,ミャンマーにおける意思決定者たちに,地域の経済状況について知ってもらえる物語を書きました. そして,我々の弱点は何なのか,そして,それに対してどのように準備すべきか.
2020-s-0439.impactJa: この記事は英語とミャンマー語の両方で印刷版とオンライン版で公開されています.英語版では9.1kでウェブで共有され,ミャンマー版では3.6kで共有されています.ミャンマータイムズ紙はミャンマーで最も優れたメディアの一つで,全国各地で配布され,政府政策立案者,議会議員,市民社会,NGO,INGO,シンクタンク組織を含む多くのオーディエンスを持っています. 現在,ミャンマータイムズには1700万人の読者がネット上で,フェイスブックページでは460万人が読んでいます.これは2019年のミャンマータイムズで最も視聴された記事です.政策立案者,議会議員,市民社会や他の組織は経済状況を知っています. 経済の発展に備える方法や政策を決める方法や実施プロセスを楽しみにしていました

2020-s-0440.summary: Maldito Dato is a project of the non-profit Spanish media outlet Maldita.es. In Maldito Dato we belittle the statements of politicians with research through requests for public information and data journalism methodology. During the last year Maldito Dato had published more than 400 pieces and all of them used public information, data systematization and analysis and traditional reporting techniques. This seven pieces show how our work method can be used in different topics with simple and clear language for all kinds of publics.
2020-s-0440.impact: The content created by Maldito Dato had 1.065.000 unique visitors and 2.152.600 views in our web page in 2019. During the year our material had been republised or quoted in almost 100 media outlets in TV, radio and digital. Some of the media outlets that did it are Telemadrid, El Confidencial, El Español, El Mundo, Cadena Ser, eldiario.es, ABC and Onda Madrid, among others. We also had impact in the application of transparency laws. For example, one of the pieces we are sending titled “Televisión Española paga 480.000 euros a Shine Iberia por cada programa de MasterChef Celebrity y 490.000 por los Junior” (Spanish Televisión pay 480.000 euros to Shine Iberia for every show of MasterChef Celebrity and 490.00 for the Junior), was a long legal process to get the information that allow us to discover, for the first time in Spain, how many money the public television spend in external tv show. Or in the case of the publication “El 44% de los bares y restaurantes madrileños inspeccionados en 2019 presentó problemas de higiene: consulta qué incumplieron y sus inspecciones” (The 44% of the pubs and restaurants inspected in Madrid in 2019 had hygiene problems) was the first time that the local administration of Madrid delivered this data to public, and now is a tool for social audit.
2020-s-0440.authors: Ignacio Calle, Sergio Sangiao, José Molina, Adela Vived, Rubén Díaz, Julio Montes, Clara Jiménez Cruz
2020-s-0440.summaryJa: Maldito Datoは非営利のスペインのメディア機関 Maldita.esのプロジェクトです Maldito Datoでは,公情報とデータジャーナリズム方法論の要請を通じて政治家たちの声明を研究することによって軽視しています. この7つの作品は,あらゆる種類の公衆のためのシンプルで明確な言語で,私たちの作業方法が異なるトピックでどのように使用できるかを示しています.
2020-s-0440.impactJa: Maldito Datoによって作成されたコンテンツは2019年に 1.065.000 件のユニーク訪問者と 2.152.600 件のビューを記録しました.その年に私たちの素材はテレビ,ラジオ,デジタルでほぼ100のメディア・アウトレーットでリポリシブまたは引用されました.それをしたメディアのいくつかはテレマドリッド,エル・コンフィデンシャル,エル・スペイン,エル・ワールド,カデナ・セル,エル・ダイアリオ.エス,ABC,そしてオンド・マドリッドなどです. 例えば,私たちが送っている作品の一つは"スペインテレビはマスターシェフ・セレブティの番組ごとに Shine Iberia に48万ユーロ,ジュニアに49万ユーロを支払います"というタイトルで, スペインテレビは"マスターシェフ・セレブティの番組ごとに Shine Iberia に48万ユーロ,ジュニアに490.00ユーロを支払います. マドリルで2019年に検査されたバーとレストランの44%が衛生問題を示しました:何に違反したか調べてみました

2020-s-0441.summary: We have compiled a database of two hundred articles from the Kyrgyz media over the past five years about rape, beatings and murders of children. And they tried to understand what unites these cases and why there is violence against children.
2020-s-0441.impact: The project did not resonate, but I think that it can change the views of readers and move them to action.

2020-s-0442.summary: Our #LockedOut investigation revealed just how hard it was to find an affordable property to rent while on housing benefits. We dug into data from across Great Britain to show, not only the state of affairs nationally, but also the local, granular picture. This collaborative project drew in journalists from across the country to tell an important story about the housing crisis and a leading cause of our spiralling homelessness epidemic.
2020-s-0442.impact: The work was welcomed by campaigners and lawyers across the country, with some officials saying it would help them create local policy. We heard of at least one legal case where lawyers used our data to prove their client and his family were unable to access an affordable home. The work also prompted the UN Special Rapporteur on Housing to speak out on the issue and, inspired by our work she said she planned to look into affordability as an issue elsewhere. Three months after publication the government announced an increase in the rate of Local Housing Allowance (housing benefit), though we have since shown this increase does little to improve things.
2020-s-0442.authors: Maeve McClenaghan, Charles Boutaud, Tom Blount, Charlotte Maher
2020-s-0442.summaryJa: 住宅保険の支払いで住房の賃貸に適格な不動産を見つけることがどれほど難しいか,調査で明らかになりました.我々は,国内での状況だけでなく,地域での詳細な状況を示すために,イギリス全土からのデータを掘り下げました.この共同プロジェクトでは,住房危機と私たちの急激なホームレス病の主要な原因についての重要な話を伝えるために,全国のジャーナリストを集めました.
2020-s-0442.impactJa: 法律事務所は,この件について,この件について,法律事務所の職員に報告した.この件について,この件について,法律事務所の職員に報告した.この件について,法律事務所の職員に報告した. 公開後3ヶ月間政府は地方住居補助金 (住宅給与) の増額を発表したが,この増額が改善にほとんど貢献していないことが示されています.

2020-s-0443.summary: Dying Homeless project - a year long, collaborative investigation - revealed for the first time, the scale of homeless deaths across the UK. After discovering that no official body held data on how and when people were dying homeless we started counting, aware that this deficit of information meant no-one knew how wide-scale this issue was or whether lessons could be learnt to prevent deaths in the future. We revealed that at least 800 people died (October 2017 - April 2019). We logged the names and stories of hundreds of people who had lost their lives.
2020-s-0443.impact: The findings set the news agenda, provoked debates in parliament, and prompted Ministers to promise to do more to address the issue. The Secretary of State for Housing called our findings “utterly shocking” and promised case reviews into deaths. Following our revelations about the lack of reviews into homeless deaths, several councils, including Brighton & Hove and Leeds have said they will undertake their own reviews into deaths in their area. The government’s Rough Sleeper Strategy recommended, for the first time, that deaths be reviewed. We started our series using #makethemcount: a call for an official body to log these deaths. In December, prompted by our work, the Office for National Statistics produced the first ever official data on homeless deaths. This came after we shared our data with the ONS to help them develop their methodology. The Scottish National Records Office has now followed suit and will soon publish its first ever data on homeless deaths. The Northern Irish equivalent has said it is exploring producing its own data now too. We presented the findings to the APPG on Homelessness and the figures have been cited in parliament several times. Prompted by our network of reporters, at least 17 MPs and councillors have spoken out on the issue. The work was also received positively by those working with and for homeless people. The Big Issue said: “To its huge credit, the Bureau’s research extensively looked into the stories of every one of those deaths… Putting faces and stories to numbers humanised the figure”. Across the country, members of the public came together to remember those that passed away. There were protests about homeless deaths in Belfast, Birmingham, London and Manchester, memorial services in Brighton, Oxford, Luton and London, and physical markers erected in Long Eaton and Northampton
2020-s-0443.summaryJa: 死亡者ホームレスプロジェクト (Dying Homeless Project) は,一年間続いた共同調査で,初めて,英国全域でホームレス死亡者の規模を明らかにしました.ホームレスで死亡する人々の方法や時期に関する公式機関が保有していないことを発見した後,私たちは情報不足が意味すると,この問題はどれほど広範囲であるか,将来死亡を防ぐために教訓を学ぶことができるかを知らなかったことを認識し,数え始めました.少なくとも800人が死亡したことが明らかになりました (2017年10月 - 2019年4月). 命を落とした何百人もの人の名前や物語を記録しました
2020-s-0443.impactJa: 住宅国務長官は,我々の発見を"極めて衝撃的な"と称し,死亡事件の事例レビューを約束した.ホームレス死亡事件のレビュー不足に関する我々の発表の後,ブライトン&ホーブとリーズを含むいくつかの理事会は,自分たちの地域における死亡事件の自身のレビューを行うことを宣言した. 政府の"粗眠者戦略"は,初めて死亡者レビューを推奨しました.私たちは#makethemcountを使ってシリーズを開始しました.この死亡者数を記録する公式機関を呼び出しました.12月に,私たちの作業によって,国家統計局はホームレス死亡者に関する最初の公式データを作成しました.これは,彼らの方法論を開発するのに役立つために,私たちは私たちのデータをONSと共有した後でした. スコットランド国立記録局は,今この例を踏まえており,近いうちにホームレス死亡に関する最初のデータを公表する予定です.北アイルランド同級は,今も独自のデータを公開しようと考えていると語っています.我々はホームレスに関するAPPGにこの結果を提示し,この数字は議会で何度も引用されています.我々の記者ネットワークによって,少なくとも17人の議員と議員がこの問題について発言しました. ブルック・エスジューは"この研究では,この死者の一人ひとりの物語を詳しく調べた.顔や物語を数字に描いたことは,この数字を人間化した.全国で,市民が集まり,亡くなった人々を思い出しました. ベルファスト,バーミンガム,ロンドン,マンチェスターでホームレスの死者に対する抗議活動, ブライトン,オックスフォード,ルトン,ロンドンでの記念儀式, ロング・イートン,ノースハンプトンで物理的なマークが設置された

2020-s-0444.summary: This interactive narrative shows why decision-making algorithms can’t be completely fair when operating on data from an unfair world. It visualizes real data used in an algorithmic system to predict whether an individual will be re-arrested. It then challenges readers to adjust the algorithm to make those predictions fairer. But after every adjustment, a new notion of fairness is revealed requiring more adjustment. This build up leads to the punchline: these notions, in practice, can never be satisfied all at once. While the story uses criminal justice data, it’s lesson holds true across industries, including in hiring, healthcare, and lending.
2020-s-0444.impact: Our exploration of algorithmic bias, while grounded in an example from the criminal justice system, is widely applicable across industries and fields that are increasingly adopting automated decision-making systems. We received feedback from readers across many fields—criminal justice, law, AI, social sciences, and healthcare—saying that our piece has become an important reference and/or teaching tool for understanding the impact and consequences of this phenomenon. Overall our piece has received over 80,000 views and been publicly commended by leading experts and institutions like AI Now, Azeem Azhar, Janelle Shane, and Mary Gray. It has also been featured on radio and podcasts and become assigned reading in university courses, including at Stanford University. While it’s difficult to track impact beyond these metrics, its wide reach shows how relevant and salient this topic is. As we’re seeing now, governments around the world have begun to actively draft legislation to address such bias. The work of researchers and journalists like us plays a critical role in helping policymakers understand how to regulate this issue. In the meantime, it’s also important to have a robust public conversation that unveils and elevates the weaknesses of algorithmic systems to the people affected by them so they can push back.
2020-s-0444.summaryJa: このインタラクティブな物語は,不公平な世界からのデータで操作する際の意思決定アルゴリズムが完全に公正になれない理由を示しています. アルゴリズムでは,個人が再逮捕されるかどうかを予測するためにアルゴリズムシステムで使用される実際のデータを視覚化します. その後に読者にアルゴリズムを調整して,これらの予測をより公平にするよう挑戦します. しかし,調整ごとに,より調整を必要とする公平性の新しい概念が明らかになります. 犯罪司法のデータを使用している一方で,雇用,医療,融資などすべての業界においてこの教訓は真実である.
2020-s-0444.impactJa: 刑事司法制度の例を踏まえて,アルゴリズム偏見の調査は,自動化された意思決定システムをますます採用している産業や分野に広く適用されています. 刑事司法,法律,人工知能,社会科学,保健など多くの分野における読者からフィードバックを受け取り,この現象の影響と結果を理解するための重要な参考や教材になったと述べています. 作品全体で8万件以上ビューがあり,著名な専門家や機関から公に賞賛され,AI Now,Azeem Azhar,JanelleCShane/status/11848776320271104やJanelle Shane,そしてMary Gray. また, radio と podcasts で紹介され,大学コースでスタンフォード大学 で,その影響を追跡することは困難であるが,その幅はこのトピックがどれほど関連的で顕著であることを示しています. 現在,世界各国の政府は,このような偏見に対処するために積極的に立法を起草し始めている.私たちのような研究者やジャーナリストの仕事は,政策立案者がこの問題をどのように規制するか理解するのに重要な役割を果たしています.その間,アルゴリズムシステムの弱点を明らかにし,その影響を受けた人々に引き返せるようにする強力な公共の会話も重要です.

2020-s-0445.summary: BudgetPromises.Org is an online platform launched in 2017 that tracks implementation of selected budget proposals in Sri Lanka. The platform addresses two questions on government's national budget: Is the government doing what it is saying? Is the government saying what it is doing? As such, the platform tracks the level of progress in implementation of budget proposals as well as the openness of the government in sharing information relating to the implementation of budget proposals. The platform is run by Verité Research, an independent think tank in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
2020-s-0445.impact: The key impact of BudgetPromises.Org has been changing the conversation about the government budget from ‘promise-making’ to ‘promise-keeping’. Since its inception, there was a notable shift in government discourse from making promises to keeping promises. Usually, discussions in parliament as well as the media during the budget speech focus exclusively on costs and benefits of new proposals. However, because of the influence of our platform, these discussions shifted to also focus on the importance of having systems in place to monitor the implementation of promises. These discussions also started to shift to the need for budgets to be formulated better. In the mid-year assessment of the 2018 budget, we succeeded in changing the discourse from promise-making to promise-keeping. We focused on making government institutions accountable. In the most recent phase, the end-year assessment, we took the next step to highlight the importance of transparency—that is the importance of government being willing to proactively share information about the status of budget implementation with the public. The platform’s major impact lies in its ability to sustain the conversation about accountability and governance around budget issues in an environment where the media only talks about the budget when it is discussed by a politician. We also observed a positive change in how the government monitors its own spending. In March 2019, the Minister of Finance announced that six committees would be appointed to monitor the implementation of budget proposals. Like many statements made by Sri Lankan politicians, the minister’s promise might not actually amount to a change in practice any time soon. However, in the Sri Lankan context, even the fact that the Minister feels obliged to reassure the public that the government will be engaging in better monitoring of the budget is a win for democracy.
2020-s-0445.authors: Nishan de Mel, Subhashini Abeysinghe, Hasna Munas, Faiza Chathoor, Nilangika Fernando, Vidhya Nathaniel, Lahiri Jayasinghe, Chalani Ranwala
2020-s-0445.summaryJa: 予算約束.Org は,スリランカで選ばれた予算提案の実施を追跡する2017年に開始されたオンラインプラットフォームです.このプラットフォームは政府の国予算に関する2つの質問に答えます. 予算提案の実施に関する情報共有の率や政府のオープン性について,このプラットフォームは追及しています.このプラットフォームは,スリランカのコロンボにある独立したシンクタンクであるVerité Researchによって運営されています.
2020-s-0445.impactJa: 予算約束の主要な影響は,政府予算に関する会話を"約束する"から"約束を守る"に変えています.その成立以来,政府演説は約束するから約束を守るに顕著な変化がありました.通常,議会での議論と予算演説のメディアは,新しい提案のコストと利益だけに焦点を当てています. 予算の制定が重要であり,予算の実施を監視するシステムがあることが重要であることに焦点を当てました.この議論は,予算のよりよい策定の必要性にも変わりました.2018年の予算の年中評価では,私たちは約束の実現から約束の履行へと議論を変えることに成功しました.我々は政府機関を責任者にするために焦点を当てました. 最新段階である年末評価において,我々は透明性の重要性を強調するために次のステップを踏み出した. メディアは予算について政治家によって議論されるときにのみ話している環境で,予算問題に関する説明責任と統治に関する会話を継続する能力に大きく影響している.また,政府が自身の支出を監視する方法にもポジティブな変化が見られました. 2019年3月,財務大臣は予算案の実施を監視するために6つの委員会が任命されると発表した.スリランカの政治家たちが述べた多くの声明と同様に,大臣の約束は,実際は,すぐに実践の変化に等しくないかもしれない. しかし,スリランカの状況では,政府が予算の監視を良くするとの公衆を安心させる義務を大臣が感じていることさえも,民主主義の勝利です.

Two years later, as the deadline approached, everyone had forgotten about it. Meanwhile, refugee agencies trying to get people out of barbaric detention camps in Libya were complaining that the promised resettlement opportunities were slow in forthcoming - prolonging the suffering of desperate people. Enquiries to the European Commission revealed that the program was way behind. We collected data from 20 countries to produce an accountability piece revealing who had failed to deliver otheir pledges to help people in desperate
2020-s-0446.impact: The story was one of the most-read articles of the week on the DW English website. The story was also told in TV form, in a segment on DW's English-language news bulletins including The Day, the evening program which is rebroadcast by PBS and other partners around the world. On radio, the story was reported in DW's AfricaLink programme, which is broadcast on FM partner stations in Cameroon, Ghana, Kenya, Liberia, Malawi, Namibia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, South Sudan, Uganda and Zambia, as well as online via Facebook and podcast platforms. The story was followed up by international media outlets including the Jerusalem Post, as well as being syndicated by DW's partner media. The story was widely shared on Twitter and Facebook, including by experts in the field.

2020-s-0446.impactJa: この記事はDW英語ウェブサイトで週で最も読まれている記事の一つでした.また,DW英語のニュース・ブレーテンのセグメントで,DWの夕方番組The Dayを含むテレビ形式で伝えられました. 放送はDWのAfricaLink番組で放送された.この番組はカメルーン,ガーナ,ケニア,リベリア,マラウィ,ナミビア,ナイジェリア,シエラレオネ,南スーダン,ウガンダ,ザンビア,フェイスブック,ポッドキャストプラットフォームを通じてオンラインで放送された.このニュースはエルサレムポストを含む国際メディアがフォローし,DWのパートナーメディアが配信した. この話はTwitterやFacebookで広く共有され,専門家はその分野をはじめました.

2020-s-0447.summary: The Telegraph's top-performing coverage during the 2019 UK General Election all had data journalism at the heart of it. Our interactive results forecaster was more accurate than the official exit poll, and our tactical voting tool, the only one by a major publisher to feature a guide for both Remain and Leave supporters, was our second most prolific subscription-driving piece of content ever. The data team's decision to make a live Brexit-focused graphic one of the centrepieces of our results page paid off with record audience and engagement figures.
2020-s-0447.impact: The Telegraph’s live 2019 General Election results page had the reader at the heart of it. We were the only UK publication to have a Brexit-focused graphic live-updating on our results page, with our histogram of Brexit vote versus party gains proving essential in telling anyone the story. Brexit proved the driver of the swings seen in the election, and our gamble with making a live Brexit-focused graphic one of our centrepieces paid off. It meant that we were able to provide visual-led updates of the stories of the election (e.g. https://twitter.com/Ashley_J_Kirk/status/1205325253800529927) without having to due any heavy-lifting in ggplot or Illustrator. It also helped with a high reader engagement time, which in turn meant that the page led Google more than any other news publisher and attracted record page view figures from our core subscriber audience Our data-driven stories for the election were among the most-subscribed pieces for The Telegraph this year. When it came to the results analysis, our Data Journalism team of three was aided due to the fact that we had an innovative toolkit of live-updating, diverse and story-driven results graphics. These graphics went beyond the standard live bar chart or map which show seat totals; we took a risk on understanding what the stories of the night were likely to be, as well as audience’s needs, and created the graphics based on this. Our results page contained nine live-updating graphics, and each of these was a component that could be embedded in any other article. These individual embeds - called Particles - were then embedded in lots of pieces of online content, which helped lift the bar of our overall visual storytelling. We had millions of pageviews and our data journalism included some of the Telegraph's highest-ever subscribed content to date.
2020-s-0447.authors: Ashley Kirk, Richard Moynihan, Oliver Edgington, Bruno Riddy, George Ioakeimidis, Abby Rose, Ed Goldman
2020-s-0447.summaryJa: 2019年イギリス総選挙の際テレグラフのトップパフォーマンス報道は全てデータジャーナリズムを中心にしていました. 私たちのインタラクティブな結果予測は公式の出口調査よりも正確でした.そして,主要な出版社がRemainとLeaveの支持者の両方のためのガイドを備えた唯一の戦術投票ツールは,私たちの2番目に生産的なサブスクリプションを駆使するコンテンツでした. データチームの決定は離脱を中心としたライブグラフィックを結果ページの中心部に記録的な視聴率とエンゲージメントの数字で成果をあげました
2020-s-0447.impactJa: 2019年総選挙結果の直播ページは読者を中心にしていました.私たちは英国唯一の出版社で,結果ページにブレグジットに焦点を当てたグラフィックライブ更新を掲載しました.ブレグジット投票と党の勝利のヒストグラムは,誰にでも物語を伝える上で不可欠であることが証明されました.ブレグジットは選挙で目撃された波動のドライバーであることが証明されました.そして,ブレグジットに焦点を当てたグラフィックを直播することで私たちの賭けは,私たちの中心的な作品の一つに報じられました. 選挙の物語の視覚的な更新を提供することができました (例えば,GGplotやIllustratorで重荷を負わさずに https://twitter.com/Ashley_J_Kirk/status/1205325253800529927). また読者の関わり時間が高くなりページは他のニュース出版社よりもGoogleを率いておりページビューの記録的な数字を集めました投票のためのデータに基づく私たちの記事は今年のテレグラフ誌に最も登録された作品です成果分析に関しては,データジャーナリズム3人組のチームにはライブアップデート,多様なストーリーベースの結果グラフィックの革新的なツールキットが備わっていたので,助けられました.このグラフィックは,座席総数を示す標準的なライブバーチャートや地図を超えて,夜中の物語や視聴者のニーズを理解するためにリスクを取って,このに基づいてグラフィックを作成しました. 成果ページには9つのライブ更新グラフィックが含まれていて,それらの各要素は他の記事に埋め込むことができる要素でした. これらの個々の埋め込み物 (Particles) は,オンラインコンテンツの多くのパーツに埋め込まれ,全体的な視覚的なストーリーテリングのバーを上げることに役立ちました.私たちは何百万人ものページビューがあり,データジャーナリズムにはテレグラフのこれまでに最も登録されたコンテンツが含まれています.

2020-s-0448.summary: Our machine-learning General Election predictor - unmatched by any other publisher - was borne out of collaboration with our data science and graphics teams. To coincide with the release of the official 10pm exit, we generated our own accurate seat-by-seat forecast of the results. Our forecasting model was closer to the final outcome than the exit poll, and that Labour’s vote share would hold up slightly better in certain areas. This was because of the wealth of data it took in: the last five national elections; demographic data and the latest polling data. ​
2020-s-0448.impact: Our forecaster’s success lies not in the fact that complex methods were used, but that they were communicated in an accessible fashion - we feel the pursuit of this clarity is just as important as the pursuit of technological development. This helped drive the impact of this project. On social media, animated gifs were used to increase the impact of what some would see as quite a dull, numbers-heavy topic (https://twitter.com/Telegraph/status/1205276976396873728). Our first forecast had the Conservatives on 363 and Labour on 201 (which you can see from 10.23PM on the night here https://twitter.com/Ashley_J_Kirk/status/1205251919452786688). This was just two seats short for both major parties. Our very first forecast correctly called some of the biggest results of the night, such as that Jo Swinson would lose her seat, Luciana Berger and Chuka Umunna would fail to take Remain-London seats, and Dominic Raab would cling on despite a Lib Dem surge. The BBC's exit poll originally put the Conservatives on 368 and Labour on 191, so we were closer to the final result (BBC +3 for Con, we were -2; BBC -12 for Lab, we were -2). The impact of this was that Telegraph readers were able to see who their own area was likely to be represented by even before the results had come in. Our metrics showed that this piece of data journalism is something that they were interested in, with the piece being one of the most subscribed and viewed pieces on results night. ​
2020-s-0448.authors: Ashley Kirk, Patrick Scott, Davoud Ardali, Yves Jacquot, Sam Moppett, Josh Wilson
2020-s-0448.summaryJa: 機械学習による総選挙予測は,他の出版社に比べないもので,データ科学とグラフィックチームとの連携により作成されました.公式な10時出口発表に一致するため,私たちは自分の正確な座席対座予想を生成しました.我々の予測モデルは出口調査よりも最終的な結果に近いので,労働党の投票率は特定の分野では少し改善されます. 統計学者は,過去5回の全国選挙,人口統計データ,最新の民調調査データなど,
2020-s-0448.impactJa: 予測者の成功は,複雑な方法が用いられたことではなく,アクセス可能な方法で伝えられたことにある.この明確性を追求することは,技術開発の追求と同じくらい重要なことだと考え,このプロジェクトの影響を推進するのに役立つ. ソーシャルメディアでは,アニメーションのギフが利用され,一部の者がかなり退屈で数字が重く話題だと考えるものの影響を高めるために使用されました.最初の予測は保守党が363日に,労働党が201日に (夜中の10時23分からここで見ることができます https://twitter.com/Ashley_J_Kirk/status/12052519452786688). 初めての予測は正しかったのですがジョ・スウィンソン氏が席を失うこと,ルシアナ・ベルガーとチュカ・ウムンナがリメイン・ロンドン席を奪うこと,ドミニク・ラアブはリバ・デムが激增したにもかかわらず座り続けることなど, BBCの出口調査では保守党は368位,191位に並びましただから最終結果に近づいたのです (BBC +3はCONで,2はBBC -12はLabで,2でした). データのジャーナリズムが興味のあるものだと示しましたこの作品は結果の夜で最も登録され視聴された作品の一つです

2020-s-0449.summary: “ Bosnian institutions and public companies last year launched tenders to procure 1,666 official vehicles, worth about 46 million euros, BIRN’s new database shows.” This lede, which was published in January 2019 on BIRN’s flagship website, announced the publication of data on all funds spent on vehicles for government officials, institutions and public companies in one place. The investigation and database offer a live, one-of-a-kind tool which ensures transparency of public spending. They have already proved to be a valuable anti-corruption tool, revealing that in 80 per cent of all tenders for vehicles, only one company applies for the procurement.
2020-s-0449.impact: The impact of BIRN’s database has been multifaceted. During the course of its existence, various posts, tenders and articles published on the database were republished a total of more than 250 times by domestic and regional media – showing an immense interest in the content. Along with direct users of the database, which numbered tens of thousands, the database also garnered significant amounts of posts on social media. In some instances, our posts on social media were reworked into articles by other media. One of our posts was about how we used the keyword “ISOFIX” in the database to reveal all the car purchases in which a child car seat was requested - in order to show that these cars will definitely be used for private purposes - and posted the link to the results on twitter. Our post simply provided the link to the database, in which 11 such cars with child seat requests were listed. Several media outlets then took this post and wrote long-form articles about the phenomenon. Along with republications and our direct engagement with the general readership, a specific part of our audience was the Public Procurement Agency, which is in charge of the tenders, in order to stop illegal work. As previously mentioned, we marked certain tenders with a RED FLAG. In dozens of cases, these tenders were amended after BIRN Bosnia wrote about them, or flagged them, or asked institutions questions about them. This is a very direct way in which BIRN's work stopped potentially corrupt tenders, and saved public funds through ensuring the transparency of spending. It becase for media in Bosnia and Herzegovine "only relevant source of information for Governments Officials Limos in BiH", as quoted.
2020-s-0449.summaryJa: <unk>ボスニアの機関と公営企業は昨年,約4600万ユーロの1,666台の公営車両の購入の招標を開始した. BIRNの新しいデータベースによると, 調査とデータベースは,公共支出の透明性を保証する,実用的でユニークなツールを提供しており,すでに腐敗対策の貴重なツールであることが証明されており,すべての車両のオファーの80%で,購入に申請しているのは1社のみであることが明らかになりました.
2020-s-0449.impactJa: BIRN<unk>のデータベースの影響は多面的です.その存在の間に,データベースに掲載された様々な投稿,招標,記事は,本土および地域メディアによって合計250回以上再刊行されました.コンテンツに莫大な関心を示しました. 数十万もの直接利用者と共に,データベースはソーシャルメディアで重要な量の投稿も集めた. ソーシャルメディア上の投稿は他のメディアの記事に改編された.ある記事では,データベースのキーワード"ISOFIX"を活用して,子供座席の要求を受けたすべての購入を明らかにし,これらのクルマは間違いなくプライベート目的で使用されることを示すために,ツイッターで結果へのリンクを投稿した.私たちの投稿は単にデータベースへのリンクを提供した. メディアのいくつかはこの記事を取り上げ,この現象について長篇記事を書きました. 共和制や一般読者との直接的な関わりとともに,私たちの聴衆の特定の一部は,違法な作業を止めるために招標を担当する公共調達機関でした. 先ほど述べたように,私たちは特定の招標をレッドフラグでマークしました. バイアン・ボスニアは,BIRNがこれらの tenderについて書いたり,マークしたり,または機関に質問をした後,数十件でこれらの tenderを修正した.これは,BIRNの作業が潜在的に腐敗した tenderを阻止し,支出の透明性を確保することによって公共資金を節約した非常に直接的な方法です.ボスニア・ヘルツェゴーヴィンのメディアは"BHの政府関係者Limosの情報源のみ"である.

2020-s-0450.summary: The project aimed to track the impact of Hong Kong's protests on multinational corporations through analysis of corporate earnings call transcripts. Through applying a natural language processing model, we were able to find many companies beyond those that had an obvious connection with Hong Kong or a brand presence in the city, such as payments processors, recruitment consultants, chicken farms and Crocs, the shoemaker.
2020-s-0450.impact: The project allowed us to cut through the euphemisms and obfuscatory language used by analysts and corporate executives to find words and phrases that were loosely associated with the protests but still relevant - for example, ``the political thing'' was how one described the growing unrest. By broadening the scope of companies covered with a minimum of time spent, it allowed a few reporters to quickly grasp a large swathe of the local economy in one fell swoop - and make the case to our readers that consumption patterns in Hong Kong are shifting, brands are increasingly looking to mainland Chinese markets and the former British colony is losing its allure as a shopping destination and a jumping-off point for executives travelling to the rest of the country.
2020-s-0450.summaryJa: プロジェクトでは,企業収益通話記号の分析を通じて,香港の抗議運動が多国籍企業への影響を追跡することを目的とした.自然言語処理モデルを適用することで,香港と明らかにつながりのある企業や都市でブランドの存在を明らかにした企業以外にも多くの企業を見つけることができました. 例えば,支払い処理業者,採用コンサルタント,鶏飼育場,シューマメーカークロックスなど.

2020-s-0451.summary: Sexual violence in Australia is pervasive but rarely prosecuted, much less punished.
